flavour.en: His enemy was for endurance forged. His own waned.
flavour.zh: 他的敌人精于鏖战，而他心勉力衰。
flavour.sourceEn: His enemy was for endurance forged. His own waned.

flavour.en:
Adonia rose with eyes afire, emanating a ghastly aura, and
broke off a carving from the wall of the Throne Room.
"You think me powerless without my wand? Insult me again!"
flavour.zh:
阿多尼娅腾空，双眼燃着火焰，身周弥漫可怖气息；
她自王座厅的墙上折下一块雕刻。
“你以为没了魔杖我便无能？你真口出狂言！”
flavour.sourceEn:
Adonia rose with eyes afire, emanating a ghastly aura, and
broke off a carving from the wall of the Throne Room.
"You think me powerless without my wand? Insult me again!"

flavour.en: The strongest souls are forged through struggle and defeat.
flavour.zh: 苦难与挫折的锤炼，造就了最坚强的灵魂。
flavour.sourceEn: The strongest souls are forged through struggle and defeat.

flavour.en: After the fires, in the depths of the Winter of the World, all life in the Vastiri banded together. Whether serpent, hyena, human, or golem, hated enemies clasped hand to claw, built refuge, and fought side by side against the Abyssals. Thus, the Third Pact was born.
flavour.zh: 烈焰熄灭，世界之冬降临，瓦斯提里的众生依偎在一起。毒蛇，土狼，人类和傀儡，彼此憎恨的敌人携手并肩。它们兴建了避难所，共同对抗深渊的力量。第三盟约由此诞生了。
flavour.sourceEn: After the fires, in the depths of the Winter of the World, all life in the Vastiri banded together. Whether serpent, hyena, human, or golem, hated enemies clasped hand to claw, built refuge, and fought side by side against the Abyssals. Thus, the Third Pact was born.

flavour.en: May your resolve never waver.
flavour.zh: 愿你的决心永不动摇。
flavour.sourceEn: May your resolve never waver.

flavour.en:
Nature respects the strong
And paints the snow red
With the blood of the weak
flavour.zh:
自然滋养着强悍的灵魂，
雪地染上鲜红的血痕——
那是孱弱者的牺牲。
flavour.sourceEn:
Nature respects the strong
And paints the snow red
With the blood of the weak

flavour.en:
A sensitive few among the first settlers of Ezomyr
followed the wisps by canoe. On a misty forested
island, Cirel of Tarth stood waiting to greet them.
flavour.zh:
艾兹麦首批拓荒者中，几位心有所感之人
循微光乘舟而去。在雾霭笼罩的林中岛上，
塔斯的布莉姬正静候他们的到来。
flavour.sourceEn:
A sensitive few among the first settlers of Ezomyr
followed the wisps by canoe. On a misty forested
island, Cirel of Tarth stood waiting to greet them.

flavour.en: Danger is the price of wealth.
flavour.zh: 不入险处，焉得巨富?
flavour.sourceEn: Danger is the price of wealth.

flavour.en: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
flavour.zh: 向他献出你的躯体，你的负担也会随之而去。
flavour.sourceEn: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.

flavour.en:
"Prepare the rack, boy. And be careful with those hooks!"
- the Master Torturer's last words
flavour.zh:
“搭好架子，小子。当心铁钩！”
——拷问大师的遗言
flavour.sourceEn:
"Prepare the rack, boy. And be careful with those hooks!"
- the Master Torturer's last words

flavour.en:
Devotees of the Goddess of Lust
needed never fear her sting.
flavour.zh: 放荡女神的信徒永远无需害怕她的毒刺。
flavour.sourceEn:
Devotees of the Goddess of Lust
needed never fear her sting.

flavour.en:
The unending carnage of war
mercilessly grinds away
at body and mind.
flavour.zh:
漫漫无期的鏖战
无情地磨碎了
肉体与心灵。
flavour.sourceEn:
The unending carnage of war
mercilessly grinds away
at body and mind.

flavour.en: The blasted oak stands forever.
flavour.zh: 橡树虽已枯萎，依旧永世屹立。
flavour.sourceEn: The blasted oak stands forever.

flavour.en:
Mist of breath
Icing to lips and throat
As the warm ones choke and fall
Upon the frozen wasteland.
flavour.zh:
如斯雾气，化为冰霜刺进口鼻
那是冻原旅人窒息倒地前
最后一次的呼吸。
flavour.sourceEn:
Mist of breath
Icing to lips and throat
As the warm ones choke and fall
Upon the frozen wasteland.

flavour.en: A moment of calm before the battle can end the war.
flavour.zh: 从容一击，息鼓偃旗。
flavour.sourceEn: A moment of calm before the battle can end the war.

flavour.en:
Mindless rage will shake the world,
Cunning lies will bend it.
Reckless haste will break the world,
And into darkness send it.
flavour.zh:
盲目的愤怒引起纷争，
狡诈的谎言让战火停歇；
无知的莽撞造成仇恨，
而无尽黑暗将吞噬一切。
flavour.sourceEn:
Mindless rage will shake the world,
Cunning lies will bend it.
Reckless haste will break the world,
And into darkness send it.

flavour.en:
Remaining unseen, the Dishonoured Assassin struck
only in the depths of the harshest sandstorms.
flavour.zh:
无荣的刺客掩盖了行踪，
只待最猛烈沙暴才出手。
flavour.sourceEn:
Remaining unseen, the Dishonoured Assassin struck
only in the depths of the harshest sandstorms.

flavour.en:
"The heart is the herald.
It will tell me when it is best to strike."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.zh:
“心脏是最佳传令官，
让我知道何时该出击迎战。”
- 瓦尔女王阿兹里
flavour.sourceEn:
"The heart is the herald.
It will tell me when it is best to strike."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal

flavour.en:
"My people? I'm not doing this for them.
They belong to me. They want this for me.
Their sacrifice is a gift they give out of love
and adoration... I deserve it. I am their Queen."
flavour.zh:
“我的人民？我这么做可不是为了他们。
他们本就属于我，是他们甘愿为我付出。
他们的牺牲是出于爱与崇敬的献礼……
我配得上这一切。因为我是他们的女王。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"My people? I'm not doing this for them.
They belong to me. They want this for me.
Their sacrifice is a gift they give out of love
and adoration... I deserve it. I am their Queen."

flavour.en:
They screamed her name in adulation as they gave
their very lives. She looked on with impatience.
flavour.zh:
谄媚的他们高呼女王之名，奉献身心。
她却不耐烦地注视着一切。
flavour.sourceEn:
They screamed her name in adulation as they gave
their very lives. She looked on with impatience.

flavour.en: Bow before her... or suffer the most gruelling death imaginable.
flavour.zh: 跪伏于她，否则就面对最严厉的死亡。
flavour.sourceEn: Bow before her... or suffer the most gruelling death imaginable.

flavour.en:
"When you have nothing to hide,
you have nothing to fear."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.zh:
“无愧于心者，
何惧之有？”
——瓦尔女王阿兹里
flavour.sourceEn:
"When you have nothing to hide,
you have nothing to fear."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal

flavour.en:
"Those who dance are considered insane
by those who cannot hear the music."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.zh:
“不闻音乐者，
料定跳舞之人皆痴狂。”
——瓦尔女王阿兹里
flavour.sourceEn:
"Those who dance are considered insane
by those who cannot hear the music."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal

flavour.en: Wealth is not to be borne lightly.
flavour.zh: 千金万贯，得来不易。
flavour.sourceEn: Wealth is not to be borne lightly.

flavour.en:
The homeguard signalled for aid against a surprise attack,
but it was not their dekharas that responded.
It was Solerai herself.
flavour.zh:
族卫发出了抵抗奇袭的信号，
可回应他们的不是德卡拉，
而是索瑞自己。
flavour.sourceEn:
The homeguard signalled for aid against a surprise attack,
but it was not their dekharas that responded.
It was Solerai herself.

flavour.en:
They crawl and chitter and swarm
in the shadow of his presence.
flavour.zh:
啾鸣的它们蜂拥而至，
尾随着他的影子。
flavour.sourceEn:
They crawl and chitter and swarm
in the shadow of his presence.

flavour.en:
They found a crying child tied to a frozen pyre.
She was clad in ice, but the village was ash.
flavour.zh:
他们在冰封的火堆上发现了嚎哭的孩子。
她被寒冰紧紧包裹，村庄却已化作燃灰。
flavour.sourceEn:
They found a crying child tied to a frozen pyre.
She was clad in ice, but the village was ash.

flavour.en:
There is no safer place
Than the Belly of the Beast
flavour.zh:
如果你觉得保命奋战太过沉重，
不如就让巨兽吞入腹中。
flavour.sourceEn:
There is no safer place
Than the Belly of the Beast

flavour.en:
"Berek hid from Storm's lightning wrath
In the embrace of oblivious Frost
Repelled by ice, blinded by blizzards
Storm raged in vain
While Berek slept."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.zh:
“贝雷克凌驾风暴之巅，
怀抱一般人只敢远观的雪线；
踏遍冰河，放眼渺无人烟，
深夜狂风恶梦无限，
他竟睡得香甜。”
——贝雷克及抗驯者
flavour.sourceEn:
"Berek hid from Storm's lightning wrath
In the embrace of oblivious Frost
Repelled by ice, blinded by blizzards
Storm raged in vain
While Berek slept."
- Berek and the Untamed

flavour.en:
"From Frost's ice-bound pass
Berek taunted and jeered
Until furious Flame scaled the mountain
Berek escaped through the thaw
And Frost's tortured moans."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.zh:
“贝雷克伫立冰封之道，
对自己征服此地得意逍遥。
那烈炎发出尖啸，
贝雷克却能躲过火烧
以及冷酷的撕咬。”
——贝雷克及抗驯者
flavour.sourceEn:
"From Frost's ice-bound pass
Berek taunted and jeered
Until furious Flame scaled the mountain
Berek escaped through the thaw
And Frost's tortured moans."
- Berek and the Untamed

flavour.en:
"With Flame licking at his heels
Berek berated the clouds
Until vengeful Storm spewed forth his rains
And Berek held on tight
As Fire screamed and steamed
And fled."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.zh:
“灾祸的火焰就在脚下翻滚，
贝雷克却充耳不闻；
接着，他感受到雨水划过风暴之后的余温，
于是打起精神，
却感叹自己无法
浴火新生。”
——贝雷克及抗驯者
flavour.sourceEn:
"With Flame licking at his heels
Berek berated the clouds
Until vengeful Storm spewed forth his rains
And Berek held on tight
As Fire screamed and steamed
And fled."
- Berek and the Untamed

flavour.en:
The limit of our knowledge is a barrier
that protects us from ourselves.
flavour.zh:
知识的局限是一道屏障，
让我们不被自己所害。
flavour.sourceEn:
The limit of our knowledge is a barrier
that protects us from ourselves.

flavour.en: Trifle not with the trinket mage.
flavour.zh: 不要招惹饰品法师。
flavour.sourceEn: Trifle not with the trinket mage.

flavour.en:
As the sun rises and the light approaches,
so too shall your enemies fear you.
flavour.zh:
日出东方，光芒现世，
敌人也将为你胆寒。
flavour.sourceEn:
As the sun rises and the light approaches,
so too shall your enemies fear you.

flavour.en: Some families have peculiar gifts...
flavour.zh: 有些家族的礼物属实诡异……
flavour.sourceEn: Some families have peculiar gifts...

flavour.en: The soul cannot flourish in a doubting mind.
flavour.zh: 满心疑虑困惑，灵魂便不得滋养。
flavour.sourceEn: The soul cannot flourish in a doubting mind.

flavour.en:
The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
flavour.zh: 遁形黑暗之中的猛兽最为让人恐惧。
flavour.sourceEn:
The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.

flavour.en: An Ezomyte endures.
flavour.zh: 一位艾兹麦人忍辱负重。
flavour.sourceEn: An Ezomyte endures.

flavour.en:
Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire
by whose light night is borne.
flavour.zh:
远在死亡的面纱之外，
燃烧着以黑影为柴的火光。
flavour.sourceEn:
Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire
by whose light night is borne.

flavour.en:
Molten feathers, veiled spark,
Hissing arrows from the dark.
flavour.zh:
炽羽疾驰化浊影，
烈矢奔腾照光明。
flavour.sourceEn:
Molten feathers, veiled spark,
Hissing arrows from the dark.

flavour.en:
If evil must always exist, so be it.
Embrace it. Become its master.
flavour.zh:
若邪恶必将永存，那就接受它。
拥抱它。成为它的主宰。
flavour.sourceEn:
If evil must always exist, so be it.
Embrace it. Become its master.

flavour.en:
"We survived the endless winter.
We endure the long summer.
One day, spring will return the rains."
flavour.zh:
“我们熬过了无尽的严冬。
我们挺过了漫长的酷暑。
总有一日，春雨将归来。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"We survived the endless winter.
We endure the long summer.
One day, spring will return the rains."

flavour.en:
"The Brotherhood of Silence does not set out to torture our targets.
Excruciating pain is simply a byproduct of certain... necessary methods."
flavour.zh:
“寂静联盟并没有折磨我们的目标。
极致痛苦只是……必要手段的产物。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"The Brotherhood of Silence does not set out to torture our targets.
Excruciating pain is simply a byproduct of certain... necessary methods."

flavour.en: An eye for an eye makes the whole world dead.
flavour.zh: 冤冤相报，举目皆亡。
flavour.sourceEn: An eye for an eye makes the whole world dead.

flavour.en:
"Tukohama may be asleep, but he still gives us his strength. A small
needle, an offering, and a vial... drink deeply, my son, and you
will more than survive the coming battle... you will thrive."
flavour.zh:
“图克哈马虽然已经沉睡，但依然赐予我们力量。
一枚细针，一次供奉，一瓶圣液……喝下去吧，我的孩子，
你不只能在即将到来的战斗中活下去……你必将凯旋。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Tukohama may be asleep, but he still gives us his strength. A small
needle, an offering, and a vial... drink deeply, my son, and you
will more than survive the coming battle... you will thrive."

flavour.en:
A window onto a realm of red,
where countless voices scream...
flavour.zh:
通往赤红领域的窗户，
无数个声音齐声哀嚎……
flavour.sourceEn:
A window onto a realm of red,
where countless voices scream...

flavour.en: The secret was lost with its maker.
flavour.zh: 它的奥妙已同创造者一起入了土。
flavour.sourceEn: The secret was lost with its maker.

flavour.en:
The dead man walks where
the living fear to tread.
flavour.zh:
亡者徘徊之处，
生人退避却步。
flavour.sourceEn:
The dead man walks where
the living fear to tread.

flavour.en: The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.
flavour.zh: 你的脑力可能没有极限，但你的头颅却不这么认为。
flavour.sourceEn: The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.

flavour.en: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
flavour.zh: 受人爱戴，不如为人所惧，还比较能保全性命。
flavour.sourceEn: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.

flavour.en:
"To scrape the sky,
to touch the clouds themselves,
is to know true freedom."
- Mutewind saying
flavour.zh:
“翱翔天际，
触碰流云，
方知自由为何物。”
— 哑风谚语
flavour.sourceEn:
"To scrape the sky,
to touch the clouds themselves,
is to know true freedom."
- Mutewind saying

flavour.en: The druids walk the Grelwood without fear.
flavour.zh: 韧木森林中的德鲁伊无所畏惧。
flavour.sourceEn: The druids walk the Grelwood without fear.

flavour.en:
"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity
of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men."
- Taruk of the Wildmen
flavour.zh:
“我不会前去寻水觅食，
毕竟还有那断了气的同伴遗爱人世。”
——野人塔卢克
flavour.sourceEn:
"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity
of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men."
- Taruk of the Wildmen

flavour.en: When cornered and desperate, look within for the rage to break loose.
flavour.zh: 困入死局而走投无路之时，心中的狂怒仍可助你挣脱。
flavour.sourceEn: When cornered and desperate, look within for the rage to break loose.

flavour.en: Heavy is the head.
flavour.zh: 戴冠之人，头重脚轻。
flavour.sourceEn: Heavy is the head.

flavour.en:
"A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often
required to garnish the perfect confession."
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
flavour.zh:
“想要取得招供的最好方法，
就是洒点滚烫的液化金属在罪犯身上。”
— 布鲁特斯，典狱长
flavour.sourceEn:
"A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often
required to garnish the perfect confession."
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom

flavour.en: The mark of the smith was widely known.
flavour.zh: 这位匠人的印记举世皆知。
flavour.sourceEn: The mark of the smith was widely known.

flavour.en:
"All Beidat desires is a foothold, a grip on your flesh,
on the world... he will offer you anything to get it..."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page thirty
flavour.zh:
“贝达特想要的就是一个立足点，一个抓手，
借此来掌控你的肉体，掌控世界……
为达目的，他会给你一切……”
— 圣堂囚犯的胡言，第三十页
flavour.sourceEn:
"All Beidat desires is a foothold, a grip on your flesh,
on the world... he will offer you anything to get it..."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page thirty

flavour.en:
Banished for his tragic failure,
Erian learned to hunt to survive.
flavour.zh:
悲剧失败，惨遭流放，
阿里安只能以狩猎为生。
flavour.sourceEn:
Banished for his tragic failure,
Erian learned to hunt to survive.

flavour.en: The Brinerot sail without fear of storms.
flavour.zh: 布林洛特的水手们不惧风暴。
flavour.sourceEn: The Brinerot sail without fear of storms.

flavour.en:
"One can never fully eliminate Chance, but with the right
machinations, all the outcomes may be turned in your favour..."
- Cadiro Perandus
flavour.zh:
“无论如何抹除，世间总有机遇。
只要机制得当，一切果效都能转为己用……”
——卡迪罗·佩兰德斯
flavour.sourceEn:
"One can never fully eliminate Chance, but with the right
machinations, all the outcomes may be turned in your favour..."
- Cadiro Perandus

flavour.en: "There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."
flavour.zh: “就算逃到天涯海角，也躲不开我的复仇。”
flavour.sourceEn: "There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."

flavour.en:
Forged by three brothers
so that they may recognize each other
across any distance of time or travel.
flavour.zh: 此戒由三兄弟合力铸造，即便物换星移，辗转流离，他们终究能以此相认。
flavour.sourceEn:
Forged by three brothers
so that they may recognize each other
across any distance of time or travel.

flavour.en: You can be the wick or the wax. Either way, your light goes out and mine goes on.
flavour.zh: 烛芯烛蜡皆一视同仁，火光燃尽助我等光辉。
flavour.sourceEn: You can be the wick or the wax. Either way, your light goes out and mine goes on.

flavour.en:
Forged from the blood of countless wars,
its thirst has only begun.
flavour.zh:
以无数战事的鲜血铸成，
对死亡的饥渴油然而生。
flavour.sourceEn:
Forged from the blood of countless wars,
its thirst has only begun.

flavour.en: Obedience stretches beyond the grave.
flavour.zh: 跨越生命的界限，也将会继续服从。
flavour.sourceEn: Obedience stretches beyond the grave.

flavour.en:
A Templar thinks he's righteous for flogging
himself once for every ten lashings he gives.
flavour.zh:
圣堂武僧觉得自己很正义，
因为他每施加十下鞭刑，就会鞭打自己一下。
flavour.sourceEn:
A Templar thinks he's righteous for flogging
himself once for every ten lashings he gives.

flavour.en: The Sacred Hunt ends with mercy.
flavour.zh: 神圣狩猎以仁慈作为终点。
flavour.sourceEn: The Sacred Hunt ends with mercy.

flavour.en:
Fire dances with those who doubt
Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful
Where there is no fear
There is no flame
flavour.zh:
犹豫迟疑，身陷恶火
胆怯畏惧，皮烧肉灼
唯有无惧无畏
方能业火中自得进退。
flavour.sourceEn:
Fire dances with those who doubt
Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful
Where there is no fear
There is no flame

flavour.en: The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.
flavour.zh: 信众虔诚甚笃，即便死后依旧为神服事。
flavour.sourceEn: The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.

flavour.en:
But the fool did not bow.
The fool stood and questioned.
And the fool was unwritten.
flavour.zh:
愚人未躬不敬，立于疑惑。
始终他立于疑惑。
flavour.sourceEn:
But the fool did not bow.
The fool stood and questioned.
And the fool was unwritten.

flavour.en:
When the throat roars,
As eyes weep,
When the hand grips hard
With trembling fingers,
When belly twists
Yet legs stand strong,
That is the work
Of the Defiant Heart.
flavour.zh:
喉咙嘶吼，
双眼泪流，
两手紧握，
十指颤抖，
腹部曲扭，
仍然屹立不休，
问其原因为何?
傲骨绝不屈合。
flavour.sourceEn:
When the throat roars,
As eyes weep,
When the hand grips hard
With trembling fingers,
When belly twists
Yet legs stand strong,
That is the work
Of the Defiant Heart.

flavour.en: He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.
flavour.zh: 种下燃焰余烬，收割炼狱之炎
flavour.sourceEn: He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.

flavour.en:
For those noble families obsessed
with keeping their bloodline pure,
there was a price to pay...
flavour.zh:
高贵家族痴迷于
维护血系的纯粹，
自有代价要偿付……
flavour.sourceEn:
For those noble families obsessed
with keeping their bloodline pure,
there was a price to pay...

flavour.en: The edges bend, the world flexes, the infinite spills into view.
flavour.zh: 边界开始扭曲，世界逐渐舒展，永恒映入眼帘。
flavour.sourceEn: The edges bend, the world flexes, the infinite spills into view.

flavour.en:
"Be vigilant, Nezahul! When the serpent is cornered, does it give up?
No... It waits. Then it bites the first hand it finds.
The danger of numbers is all in your mind!"
- Viper Napuatzi, instructing Royal Commander Nezahul
flavour.zh:
“保持警惕，尼札胡！毒蛇被逼入绝境时可会屈服？
不……它会等待时机，咬住眼前出现的第一只手。
你只知势众之危，岂不知困蛇之险！”
——蝰蛇娜帕齐对皇家指挥官尼札胡的训示
flavour.sourceEn:
"Be vigilant, Nezahul! When the serpent is cornered, does it give up?
No... It waits. Then it bites the first hand it finds.
The danger of numbers is all in your mind!"
- Viper Napuatzi, instructing Royal Commander Nezahul

flavour.en:
Our world was dying, but we chose to survive.
We broke free from the chains within.
flavour.zh:
我们的世界奄奄一息，但我们选择活下去。
我们挣脱了内心的枷锁。
flavour.sourceEn:
Our world was dying, but we chose to survive.
We broke free from the chains within.

flavour.en: Pain brings clarity.
flavour.zh: 身尝苦痛才看得明白。
flavour.sourceEn: Pain brings clarity.

flavour.en:
Only the High Priests could enact the sacrifices,
but all who witnessed shared in exultation.
flavour.zh:
只有高阶祭司能主持奉献仪式，
可所有见证者，都将欣喜若狂。
flavour.sourceEn:
Only the High Priests could enact the sacrifices,
but all who witnessed shared in exultation.

flavour.en: Natural decay can be twisted to dark ends.
flavour.zh: 自然的衰朽也能成为阴谋的助力。
flavour.sourceEn: Natural decay can be twisted to dark ends.

flavour.en:
Curse their vile Council,
They cast me aside as if I am some bastard child.
If they only knew the power I possess.
flavour.zh:
诅咒他们卑劣的议会。
他们把我当成杂种小孩将我排除在外。
他们并不知道我拥有的力量。
flavour.sourceEn:
Curse their vile Council,
They cast me aside as if I am some bastard child.
If they only knew the power I possess.

flavour.en:
It is often said of nobles that they live off their
peasants... sometimes, it's truer than any suspect.
flavour.zh:
人们常说，贵族是平民百姓头上的吸血鬼。
有些时候……事实确实如此，千真万确。
flavour.sourceEn:
It is often said of nobles that they live off their
peasants... sometimes, it's truer than any suspect.

flavour.en:
Death is your most important duty.
Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.
flavour.zh:
死亡是你的最高职责。
拥抱它，或是为你的血脉降下万世诅咒。
flavour.sourceEn:
Death is your most important duty.
Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.

flavour.en: Fear the fire that spreads like a plague.
flavour.zh: 蔓如毒疫的烈火，应由人畏之惧之。
flavour.sourceEn: Fear the fire that spreads like a plague.

flavour.en:
When the Red Sekhema called,
the Ardura were the first to answer.
flavour.zh:
红色丝克玛高呼之时，
阿杜拉率先前来响应。
flavour.sourceEn:
When the Red Sekhema called,
the Ardura were the first to answer.

flavour.en:
Turning, gazing, blinking,
behold the eyes of void.
Burning, razing, drinking,
your mind is destroyed.
flavour.zh:
转动，凝视，连连眨眼，
你注视虚幻之眼。
燃烧，夷平，痛饮若狂，
你已经丧心病狂。
flavour.sourceEn:
Turning, gazing, blinking,
behold the eyes of void.
Burning, razing, drinking,
your mind is destroyed.

flavour.en:
Lift it lightly, don it slow.
The spikes point out and in, you know.
flavour.zh:
轻轻拿起，缓缓戴上。
冠刺锋利，非血即伤。
flavour.sourceEn:
Lift it lightly, don it slow.
The spikes point out and in, you know.

flavour.en:
A lightless world
a silent reign
two sightless eyes
feed on your pain.
flavour.zh:
无光之界，
无声之域，
一双无视线的眼睛，
啃食着你的痛楚。
flavour.sourceEn:
A lightless world
a silent reign
two sightless eyes
feed on your pain.

flavour.en: An endless river of bodies lie in the wake of ambition.
flavour.zh: 为酬壮志，万骨皆枯。
flavour.sourceEn: An endless river of bodies lie in the wake of ambition.

flavour.en:
Lost in the Black Fen, Erian hoped that dawn would save him.
He had no idea how far away the light truly was.
flavour.zh:
阿里安迷失在黑沼中，只求黎明到来。
他不知道光明究竟降临到了何处。
flavour.sourceEn:
Lost in the Black Fen, Erian hoped that dawn would save him.
He had no idea how far away the light truly was.

flavour.en:
"You killed their Golden Sekhema. The Maraketh will think of nothing
but vengeance now." - Dimos, Advisor to General Titucius
flavour.zh:
“你害死了黄金丝克玛。
现在马拉克斯人唯有复仇这一条路了。”
— 蒂莫斯，提图库斯将军的顾问
flavour.sourceEn:
"You killed their Golden Sekhema. The Maraketh will think of nothing
but vengeance now." - Dimos, Advisor to General Titucius

flavour.en:
Kulemak sat triumphant, raising the crown.
Darkness coiled the world in eternal night.
Victory, a mere moment, came crashing down.
No conqueror, no conquered, only searing Light.
flavour.zh:
库勒马克胜利在握，高举王冠。
黑暗将世界拖入永恒长夜。
胜利不过转眼，旋即灰飞烟灭。
没有征服者，没有被征服者，唯有炽烈光辉。
flavour.sourceEn:
Kulemak sat triumphant, raising the crown.
Darkness coiled the world in eternal night.
Victory, a mere moment, came crashing down.
No conqueror, no conquered, only searing Light.

flavour.en:
"Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster
than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness,
it was there, at every turn, waiting for him."
- Azmerian legend
flavour.zh:
“西里乌斯超越狂风，力振光辉双翼
穿越沉静思绪，在他挑战凌驾黑暗之际，
那暗影总是无所不在，四处迁移。”
——阿兹莫里传说
flavour.sourceEn:
"Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster
than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness,
it was there, at every turn, waiting for him."
- Azmerian legend

flavour.en:
"The mind at the center of the swarm... K'Tash does
the thinking... but it has only one thought... hate."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page ninety-four
flavour.zh:
“位居群魔核心的大脑……科塔席负责思考……
但他满脑子只有一种思绪……憎恨。”
— 圣堂囚犯的胡言，第九十四页
flavour.sourceEn:
"The mind at the center of the swarm... K'Tash does
the thinking... but it has only one thought... hate."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page ninety-four

flavour.en: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends
flavour.zh: 目睹生命的消逝，才能深刻体会存活的价值。
flavour.sourceEn: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends

flavour.en:
The mournful music of the strings,
The creaking arch, the arrow sings.
A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.
flavour.zh:
万里征途抚弦悼，
号角起，羽矢啸，唯闻百里伤残号；
一世战魂拨琴梢，
生灵息，干戈倒，只望七步亡魂招。
flavour.sourceEn:
The mournful music of the strings,
The creaking arch, the arrow sings.
A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.

flavour.en: Anticipation is a gift.
flavour.zh: 期盼是一份礼物。
flavour.sourceEn: Anticipation is a gift.

flavour.en: The cry of death whispers in the wind.
flavour.zh: 逝亡者的呼号，化作风中耳语。
flavour.sourceEn: The cry of death whispers in the wind.

flavour.en:
"Focus. Hone your mind. Your lessers rely on the tangible.
Shed your senses, and raze them from this physical realm."
flavour.zh:
“专注。磨砺你的心智。弱者才依赖有形之物。
剥离你的感官，将他们从这个物质世界彻底抹除。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Focus. Hone your mind. Your lessers rely on the tangible.
Shed your senses, and raze them from this physical realm."

flavour.en:
"Soar. Be swift. Let none trespass here, from
above or below, lest your purpose be forfeit."
flavour.zh:
“翱翔。迅捷。无论来自天上还是地下，
勿让任何人侵犯此地，以免你的使命前功尽弃。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Soar. Be swift. Let none trespass here, from
above or below, lest your purpose be forfeit."

flavour.en:
"Hold firm. Let no word but the Mothers' turn your head.
Through your unfaltering fealty, you achieve perfection."
flavour.zh:
“坚守信念。除母神之言，勿让任何话语动摇你心。
凭借坚定不移的忠诚，你方能臻至完美。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Hold firm. Let no word but the Mothers' turn your head.
Through your unfaltering fealty, you achieve perfection."

flavour.en:
The respect of Karui warriors is hard to earn,
but lasts a lifetime... and beyond.
flavour.zh:
卡鲁战士的尊重来之不易，
但会持续一生……乃至身后。
flavour.sourceEn:
The respect of Karui warriors is hard to earn,
but lasts a lifetime... and beyond.

flavour.en: May you never hear it toll.
flavour.zh: 希望此钟永不鸣响。
flavour.sourceEn: May you never hear it toll.

flavour.en:
Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh,
until all that remained was a droplet of pure light:
The first Vaal.
flavour.zh:
夏巴夸亚的背叛遭到了神罚。
众神逐一剥夺了他们的肉体，
直到他们的身躯只残留下最后一点光沫，
那就是最早的瓦尔。
flavour.sourceEn:
Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh,
until all that remained was a droplet of pure light:
The first Vaal.

flavour.en:
Praetor Draven knew his only chance to subjugate
the Ezomytes was to catch them unaware.
flavour.zh:
执政官德莱文心知肚明，
唯有攻其不备才能征服艾兹麦人。
flavour.sourceEn:
Praetor Draven knew his only chance to subjugate
the Ezomytes was to catch them unaware.

flavour.en: Where her mouth should have been there was only a whirling, black void.
flavour.zh:
望向她双颊之间，
徒见那无底深渊。
flavour.sourceEn: Where her mouth should have been there was only a whirling, black void.

flavour.en:
While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style,
she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
flavour.zh:
德瑞虽无马雷格罗的才思，
却能善用她天生的毒刺。
flavour.sourceEn:
While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style,
she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.

flavour.en:
"Toasted or frozen
Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch
flavour.zh:
“尽管劫运当头，饱受苦楚，
吾仅留心于手中把握之物，
如同所招致的死亡般，沉默而专注。”
——“毁灭之弦”寇拉卢斯
flavour.sourceEn:
"Toasted or frozen
Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch

flavour.en: Welcome to Wraeclast.
flavour.zh: 欢迎来到瓦尔克拉斯。
flavour.sourceEn: Welcome to Wraeclast.

flavour.en:
"This was the first step in some grand design,
lost to the ages, now ours to decipher."
- Dominus, High Templar
flavour.zh:
宏伟计划终于迈出了第一步，
我们困惑已久，终于取得了进展。
——神主多米纳斯
flavour.sourceEn:
"This was the first step in some grand design,
lost to the ages, now ours to decipher."
- Dominus, High Templar

flavour.en:
For those without a home in the Vastiri, the
hot day is harsh, but the chill night is far worse.
flavour.zh:
在瓦斯提里无处安居的人们
面对着炎炎白昼，苦寒死夜。
flavour.sourceEn:
For those without a home in the Vastiri, the
hot day is harsh, but the chill night is far worse.

flavour.en: What is worse, the sting of the past, the pain of the present, or the fear of the future?
flavour.zh: 最糟糕的，究竟是过去的伤痕，现在的痛苦，还是未来的恐惧？
flavour.sourceEn: What is worse, the sting of the past, the pain of the present, or the fear of the future?

flavour.en:
Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness
And awoke its Master.
flavour.zh:
多里亚尼误闯狂乱之境，
狂乱帝国之王因其苏醒。
flavour.sourceEn:
Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness
And awoke its Master.

flavour.en:
"Why waste such a fine arrow on just one man?"
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
flavour.zh:
“何须为这一人耗费如此良箭？”
——瓦尔箭术师奇拉维
flavour.sourceEn:
"Why waste such a fine arrow on just one man?"
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer

flavour.en:
Dannig saw Seren in his mind's eye, a public ornament of
extravagance. Until she bore Cadigan a son and vanished.
Decadence covering brutality, like all Kalguuran customs.
flavour.zh:
丹宁在脑海中看见塞伦，一个浮夸的公共装饰品。
直到她为卡迪甘生下一个儿子后便消失了。
如同所有卡古兰的习俗，那是用颓废掩盖的暴行。
flavour.sourceEn:
Dannig saw Seren in his mind's eye, a public ornament of
extravagance. Until she bore Cadigan a son and vanished.
Decadence covering brutality, like all Kalguuran customs.

flavour.en:
"A thief in the night, Draven did creep,
families asleep, taken, held on high.
Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid.
Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."
flavour.zh:
“卑鄙的德莱文深夜来袭，
沉睡的人们被俘获受刑。
他自诩聪明却遗祸后代，
谁又能躲避手上的血债。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"A thief in the night, Draven did creep,
families asleep, taken, held on high.
Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid.
Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."

flavour.en: The candlemass tradition was born in a time of darkness and fear.
flavour.zh: 做烛火雕像的传统源自于黑暗和恐惧的时代。
flavour.sourceEn: The candlemass tradition was born in a time of darkness and fear.

flavour.en:
Wraeclast has suffered many great disasters,
but life always springs back anew.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔克拉斯经历过无数浩劫，
然而生命总能从灰烬中绽放。
flavour.sourceEn:
Wraeclast has suffered many great disasters,
but life always springs back anew.

flavour.en: An ancient Azmeri staff, overgrown by roots...
flavour.zh: 上古的阿兹莫里法杖被根须所缠绕……
flavour.sourceEn: An ancient Azmeri staff, overgrown by roots...

flavour.en:
In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned
to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.
flavour.zh:
传奇野猪的獠牙化作一把利器
推翻了压迫法瑞欧的永恒之民。
flavour.sourceEn:
In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned
to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.

flavour.en:
The horrors we imagined as children
still exist somewhere in the dark...
flavour.zh:
儿时想象出的恐魔，
依然潜伏于黑暗中……
flavour.sourceEn:
The horrors we imagined as children
still exist somewhere in the dark...

flavour.en:
Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken
by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.
flavour.zh: 远古的巨狼崇拜者被对所有神秘事物的极度渴望所占据。
flavour.sourceEn:
Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken
by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.

flavour.en:
"I like my vassals at sword point,
but my enemies as close as the hilt."
- Emperor Chitus
flavour.zh:
“寡人处处提防，就算封臣也得距离一剑之遥，
岂料仇敌宛若剑柄，早已潜伏身旁。”
- 切特斯大帝
flavour.sourceEn:
"I like my vassals at sword point,
but my enemies as close as the hilt."
- Emperor Chitus

flavour.en: He alone was welcome in the sacred spaces of the Titans.
flavour.zh: 泰坦的领域只欢迎他的到来。
flavour.sourceEn: He alone was welcome in the sacred spaces of the Titans.

flavour.en: The gleam of the night and howling teeth alike could not abate the rising of the sun.
flavour.zh: 暗夜无光，利齿嘶嚎，可太阳照常升起。
flavour.sourceEn: The gleam of the night and howling teeth alike could not abate the rising of the sun.

flavour.en:
Sometimes patching up your
equipment gets out of hand.
flavour.zh:
有些时候，光是修补行装
也成了一件难于登天之事。
flavour.sourceEn:
Sometimes patching up your
equipment gets out of hand.

flavour.en:
During the Winter of the World, her akhara began
shepherding jingakh across the harsh Vastiri. Sekhema
Eshtera planted the seeds of Maraketh diplomacy.
flavour.zh:
世界之冬期间，
她的阿卡拉开始引领外来人穿越严酷的瓦斯提里。
丝克玛·埃斯特拉播下了马拉克斯外交的种子。
flavour.sourceEn:
During the Winter of the World, her akhara began
shepherding jingakh across the harsh Vastiri. Sekhema
Eshtera planted the seeds of Maraketh diplomacy.

flavour.en:
The darkest clouds clashed and coupled,
giving birth to four lightning children of hate.
flavour.zh:
乌云密布，相互碰撞交迭
激发出四道仇恨的雷电。
flavour.sourceEn:
The darkest clouds clashed and coupled,
giving birth to four lightning children of hate.

flavour.en:
Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the
night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks,
which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.
flavour.zh:
丹宁雕琢维金，
以唤起米登加德那冥河峰顶的黑夜之莲
——此花仅生于灰烬与雪、星辰交汇之处。
flavour.sourceEn:
Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the
night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks,
which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.

flavour.en:
Power comes to those who seek
Death comes to those who reach
flavour.zh:
探求者将获得力量，
探取者将寻得灭亡
flavour.sourceEn:
Power comes to those who seek
Death comes to those who reach

flavour.en: Never blinking, always watching.
flavour.zh: 永不眨眼，凝视不休。
flavour.sourceEn: Never blinking, always watching.

flavour.en:
From aeons past, Dannig felt the Runefather's
gaze, challenging him. There is no honour in ease.
True greatness is torn from the jaws of defeat.
flavour.zh:
自远古以来，丹宁便感受到符文之父的目光向他发出挑战。
安逸之中没有荣耀。真正的伟大，
是从失败的血口中夺来的。
flavour.sourceEn:
From aeons past, Dannig felt the Runefather's
gaze, challenging him. There is no honour in ease.
True greatness is torn from the jaws of defeat.

flavour.en:
Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.
flavour.zh:
荣华富贵享万日，
过眼烟云又一世。
flavour.sourceEn:
Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.

flavour.en:
"You think us savages?" mused the Red Wolf, as
he pulled teeth from the Eternal's skull. "I will
show your kind the way of tooth and claw."
flavour.zh: “你认为我们是野蛮人？”血狼一边从永恒者的头骨上拔下牙齿，一边沉思道，“我会让你们这类人见识尖牙利爪之道。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"You think us savages?" mused the Red Wolf, as
he pulled teeth from the Eternal's skull. "I will
show your kind the way of tooth and claw."

flavour.en:
The power of the Allflame rends
souls just as easily as flesh.
flavour.zh:
万焚之力撕裂灵魂，
如撕裂血肉那般轻易。
flavour.sourceEn:
The power of the Allflame rends
souls just as easily as flesh.

flavour.en: Ride the western wind, and take flight.
flavour.zh: 乘西风，翔千里。
flavour.sourceEn: Ride the western wind, and take flight.

flavour.en:
Tale-women in training drink of a painful desert fruit.
Fire, they learn, springs from agony.
flavour.zh:
受训的说书人会饮下沙漠之果，
他们这才明白，烈火源于苦痛。
flavour.sourceEn:
Tale-women in training drink of a painful desert fruit.
Fire, they learn, springs from agony.

flavour.en:
He knew not why he was changing, only
that he wanted to hold his family close...
flavour.zh:
他不知道改变的理由，
只想抱紧自己的家人……
flavour.sourceEn:
He knew not why he was changing, only
that he wanted to hold his family close...

flavour.en:
"Never mind the pain, it's only... making room. Unrelated fact,
a person can live a normal life with just one kidney. Or just one
lung. You never know what Vaal technology will cost you..."
flavour.zh:
“不要在意这疼痛，它不过是在……腾出空间。顺便一提，
人单靠一颗肾或一片肺叶也能正常生活。
你永远不知道瓦尔科技会让你付出什么代价……”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Never mind the pain, it's only... making room. Unrelated fact,
a person can live a normal life with just one kidney. Or just one
lung. You never know what Vaal technology will cost you..."

flavour.en:
Tale-women may not fight directly,
for they have a much higher purpose.
flavour.zh:
说书人虽然不舞刀弄剑，
却肩负着更崇高的使命。
flavour.sourceEn:
Tale-women may not fight directly,
for they have a much higher purpose.

flavour.en:
"It may be centuries hence, but I still hold utmost faith.
The Saviour will rise, and mankind will be free."
flavour.zh:
“纵使千秋已逝，我仍怀至深信仰。
救赎者将会崛起，人类将会自由。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"It may be centuries hence, but I still hold utmost faith.
The Saviour will rise, and mankind will be free."

flavour.en:
Keep your heart as ice,
lest your passions stir.
flavour.zh:
心中须存冷酷，
莫使情绪激荡。
flavour.sourceEn:
Keep your heart as ice,
lest your passions stir.

flavour.en:
A gift from the Draíocht, lost in Darkness.
The bronze hums. The cloth sighs.
Living pieces of her, yearning to exist.
flavour.zh:
德莱契赠予的礼物，失落于黑暗之中。
青铜嗡鸣，织物叹息。
她是鲜活的碎片，渴求着存在。
flavour.sourceEn:
A gift from the Draíocht, lost in Darkness.
The bronze hums. The cloth sighs.
Living pieces of her, yearning to exist.

flavour.en:
Among the Templars, a secret few ate the sins of others.
They bore this burden to empower their hidden Order.
flavour.zh:
在圣堂武僧中，少数秘密成员以他人的罪恶为食。
他们负重前行，只为让他们的隐秘教团发展壮大。
flavour.sourceEn:
Among the Templars, a secret few ate the sins of others.
They bore this burden to empower their hidden Order.

flavour.en: To catch an animal, think like an animal.
flavour.zh: 了解你的猎物，才能驾驭你的猎矛。
flavour.sourceEn: To catch an animal, think like an animal.

flavour.en:
They clawed their way up from the agonising depths of nonexistence,
breathing deep with joy the exquisite light of meaning.
flavour.zh:
它们在不曾存在的深渊中挣扎着爬行，
为一缕意义的光辉而欢欣鼓舞。
flavour.sourceEn:
They clawed their way up from the agonising depths of nonexistence,
breathing deep with joy the exquisite light of meaning.

flavour.en:
A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn
Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.
flavour.zh:
仁慈的罪犯扫过了萨恩的街道
夺走了衰弱和悲哀之人的气息
flavour.sourceEn:
A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn
Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.

flavour.en:
Gruthkul was the Mother of Despair...
but one day, the Father will return,
and discover the fate of his children.
flavour.zh:
格鲁丝克本是绝望之母……
然终有一日，严父必将归来，
清算子嗣的命运。
flavour.sourceEn:
Gruthkul was the Mother of Despair...
but one day, the Father will return,
and discover the fate of his children.

flavour.en:
All your tomorrows lie ahead of you,
unknown and snarled to the very last.
flavour.zh:
明日未来皆无定，
万般混乱亦未宁。
flavour.sourceEn:
All your tomorrows lie ahead of you,
unknown and snarled to the very last.

flavour.en:
Faith does not make us invulnerable.
It makes us immortal.
flavour.zh:
信念无法让我们刀枪不入
但它却能让我们永不止息
flavour.sourceEn:
Faith does not make us invulnerable.
It makes us immortal.

flavour.en:
The cursed ones march forever,
On their hopeless, last endeavour.
flavour.zh:
受诅亡魂永世行军，
踏上必败无疑的远征。
flavour.sourceEn:
The cursed ones march forever,
On their hopeless, last endeavour.

flavour.en: Faith springs abundant at the edge of death.
flavour.zh: 信念在死亡的边缘涌现。
flavour.sourceEn: Faith springs abundant at the edge of death.

flavour.en: God blesses those who bless themselves.
flavour.zh: 自助而后天助。
flavour.sourceEn: God blesses those who bless themselves.

flavour.en:
Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation
only under the blessed veil of ignorance.
flavour.zh: 只有在无知的祝福之下，才能保持理智，心向文明。
flavour.sourceEn:
Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation
only under the blessed veil of ignorance.

flavour.en: The tale-women of old knew how to build anticipation.
flavour.zh: 从前的说书人知道如何吊起胃口。
flavour.sourceEn: The tale-women of old knew how to build anticipation.

flavour.en:
It was in this forsaken land, where mists shroud the world in mystery,
that thieves, murderers, and outcasts, sought refuge.
flavour.zh:
在这片被遗忘的土地上，迷雾笼罩着世间的奥秘。
宵小、凶犯与浪客寻得了栖身之地。
flavour.sourceEn:
It was in this forsaken land, where mists shroud the world in mystery,
that thieves, murderers, and outcasts, sought refuge.

flavour.en:
As their eyes adjusted, they became aware of a strange
blue light. Countless glowing worms crawled above,
blissfully unaware of their flight from the sirens.
flavour.zh:
眼目应变，化作古怪的蓝光。
无数闪光的虫子在上方爬行，
丝毫不觉他们从海妖旁逃离。
flavour.sourceEn:
As their eyes adjusted, they became aware of a strange
blue light. Countless glowing worms crawled above,
blissfully unaware of their flight from the sirens.

flavour.en: No metal slips as easily through the fingers as gold.
flavour.zh: 凡人的双手总是无法留住最贵重，也是最沉重的资产。
flavour.sourceEn: No metal slips as easily through the fingers as gold.

flavour.en: Bleeding just means you're still alive.
flavour.zh: 流淌的殷红正是你活着的象征。
flavour.sourceEn: Bleeding just means you're still alive.

flavour.en: An indomitable force of control.
flavour.zh: 不屈不折的掌控之力。
flavour.sourceEn: An indomitable force of control.

flavour.en: A wellspring of vitality bubbling from within.
flavour.zh: 从中涌现出生生不息的活力。
flavour.sourceEn: A wellspring of vitality bubbling from within.

flavour.en: Skin like steel tempered by bright flames.
flavour.zh: 像钢铁在烈火中锻造般的表面。
flavour.sourceEn: Skin like steel tempered by bright flames.

flavour.en:
Try as you like to hide the
blood on your hands.
You'll still know the truth.
flavour.zh:
尽管擦去手上的鲜血吧。
你对此心知肚明。
flavour.sourceEn:
Try as you like to hide the
blood on your hands.
You'll still know the truth.

flavour.en:
Some would question if the risk was worth it.
The rest were already dead.
flavour.zh:
有些人会质疑冒这风险是否值得。
其他人则早已死去。
flavour.sourceEn:
Some would question if the risk was worth it.
The rest were already dead.

flavour.en: In the end, even heroes fade away.
flavour.zh: 到头来，英雄豪杰终凋零。
flavour.sourceEn: In the end, even heroes fade away.

flavour.en:
Drink deeply of the Well.
Let the Abyss coil within.
flavour.zh:
痛饮魂井之水。
任由深渊在血管中游走。
flavour.sourceEn:
Drink deeply of the Well.
Let the Abyss coil within.

flavour.en:
After the eruption, the skies turned grey,
ash began to fall, and a chill set in...
flavour.zh:
熔火喷发，苍穹黯淡，
飞灰如雪，寒冬降临……
flavour.sourceEn:
After the eruption, the skies turned grey,
ash began to fall, and a chill set in...

entries.semanticNotes: The installed version has one title and element variants; current PoE2DB/Tencent have three prefixed titles. The common family name is used without replacing local modifiers.

flavour.en:
"When the Third Pact was written in stone, the Dreamer gave the alliance of men and
beasts knowledge. In return, they gave him a drop of blood; one from each of the
races of Wraeclast. In the centuries that followed, his Will began to subtly change."
- Book of the Benevolent Dreamer, Histories 220:5
flavour.zh:
“第三契约铭刻于石，幻梦者将智慧赋予人兽联盟。
作为交换，他们献给他一滴血；
来自瓦尔克拉斯每个种族的一滴血。
此后的千百年中，他的意志悄然生变。”
— 《慈爱的幻梦者之书》，编年史220:5
flavour.sourceEn:
"When the Third Pact was written in stone, the Dreamer gave the alliance of men and
beasts knowledge. In return, they gave him a drop of blood; one from each of the
races of Wraeclast. In the centuries that followed, his Will began to subtly change."
- Book of the Benevolent Dreamer, Histories 220:5

flavour.en:
"With piercing eyes, you saw through the Stillness.
Undulating as one, you gloriously covered all in white.
But... I can bear you no longer."
The Dreamer whispered with fogging breath, ice creeping down his hand.
flavour.zh:
“你以锐利目光洞悉寂静。
如波律动，你圣洁覆盖一切白芒。
可是……我无法再承受你。”
幻梦者低语，气息成雾，冰霜自他掌间蔓延。
flavour.sourceEn:
"With piercing eyes, you saw through the Stillness.
Undulating as one, you gloriously covered all in white.
But... I can bear you no longer."
The Dreamer whispered with fogging breath, ice creeping down his hand.

flavour.en:
"Power of the Red Pyre! Flaming Heart of the Hive!
I release your burning message to rest here, forevermore."
The Dreamer declared, casting out the lingering dark embers within him.
flavour.zh:
“赤焰火柱之力！虫巢的烈焰之心！
我释放你炽烈的讯息，让它在此永远安息。”
幻梦者如此宣告，将体内残存的黑暗余烬驱逐出去。

glossarySources.semanticNotes: The compound establishes 虫巢 for Hive; Flaming Heart is translated compositionally.

flavour.semanticNotes: The installed Three-line flavour is still present as English-only wiki data in the source page; the rendered bilingual card has a different older flavour. This Chinese paragraph is a manual translation, not a PoE2DB verbatim quotation. No numbers occur and no mechanics are involved.

flavour.en:
"Deep in thought, you would tremble the very air before you.
Wreathed in light, you nurtured them all.
And yet... Your nature became you."
The Dreamer mused with aching heart, as remnants of forking tendrils burst forth.
flavour.zh:
“你的沉思令空气颤抖。
你光芒四溢抚育众生。
可是……你的本性终成你自身。”
幻梦者哀叹，心痛如绞，分叉的触须残影破体而出。
flavour.sourceEn:
"Deep in thought, you would tremble the very air before you.
Wreathed in light, you nurtured them all.
And yet... Your nature became you."
The Dreamer mused with aching heart, as remnants of forking tendrils burst forth.

flavour.en:
She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.
flavour.zh:
她的思想，使我们动作。
她的动作，使我们思考。
完整的碎片洗净天空。
flavour.sourceEn:
She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.

flavour.en:
She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.
flavour.zh:
她的思想，使我们动作。
她的动作，使我们思考。
完整的碎片洗净天空。
flavour.sourceEn:
She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.

flavour.en: The first Karui born on the fringes of the Vaal empire developed a blood fever born of corruption.
flavour.zh:
首个卡鲁人诞生于瓦尔帝国边陲，
来自一场从腐化中开发血瘟的实验。
flavour.sourceEn: The first Karui born on the fringes of the Vaal empire developed a blood fever born of corruption.

flavour.en:
"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and
judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat.
The head is where the Man is."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
flavour.zh:
“骨骼是灵魂的居所，
血肉是精神和世界交流的窗口，推动一切的力量就在心窝。
即使有了这些，失去了头脑就没有自我。”
——冈姆军师拉维安加
flavour.sourceEn:
"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and
judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat.
The head is where the Man is."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom

flavour.en:
Countless souls scream in agonising harmony,
forever sinking under the weight of the newly dead.
flavour.zh:
无数魂魄在痛苦中齐声哀嚎，
永远被新亡者的重量压向深渊。
flavour.sourceEn:
Countless souls scream in agonising harmony,
forever sinking under the weight of the newly dead.

flavour.en:
When the axe finally fell, Seryl shared his pain,
and the last thought that flickered through his
fading mind was her broken, shattered scream.
flavour.zh:
斧刃落下，塞里尔感受到他的剧痛，
他在恍然垂死时只听见
塞里尔凄厉惨烈的哀嚎。
flavour.sourceEn:
When the axe finally fell, Seryl shared his pain,
and the last thought that flickered through his
fading mind was her broken, shattered scream.

flavour.en:
Give of your heated passions.
Give of your cold resolve.
You will be repaid.
flavour.zh:
投注炙热感情。
秉持不移坚定。
迎向灿烂光明。
flavour.sourceEn:
Give of your heated passions.
Give of your cold resolve.
You will be repaid.

flavour.en:
They believed themselves courageous and selfless,
but that bravery became the doom at their door.
flavour.zh:
他们相信自己的勇敢和无私，
可勇敢成为了通向末日的路。
flavour.sourceEn:
They believed themselves courageous and selfless,
but that bravery became the doom at their door.

flavour.en: Remember the past, anticipate the future.
flavour.zh: 回忆过去，预想未来。
flavour.sourceEn: Remember the past, anticipate the future.

flavour.en:
There was a very clear and delicious
reason why the Ezomytes chose to
stop their flight and settle in Phaaryl.
flavour.zh:
艾兹麦人于法瑞欧定居，
漫漫流亡就在此地终结，
源于明显而美味的理由。
flavour.sourceEn:
There was a very clear and delicious
reason why the Ezomytes chose to
stop their flight and settle in Phaaryl.

flavour.en: The younger brother waded into battle, shrugging off blows.
flavour.zh: 弟弟一步步迈向战火，对刀光剑影视而不见。
flavour.sourceEn: The younger brother waded into battle, shrugging off blows.

flavour.en: If fear doesn't kill you, I will.
flavour.zh: 如果恐惧杀不死你，我也会亲手杀了你。
flavour.sourceEn: If fear doesn't kill you, I will.

flavour.en:
"The crack of bone, the spray of blood.
Is there sweeter music?"
- Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.
flavour.zh:
“碎骨溅血之声
岂非天籁悦耳之音？”
——艾兹麦人雷姆诺。
flavour.sourceEn:
"The crack of bone, the spray of blood.
Is there sweeter music?"
- Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.

flavour.en:
Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows,
tipped with a poisoned hatred
only oppression can ferment.
flavour.zh:
西里的箭雨呼啸而来，
矢锋剧毒命中要害，
留下冰冷遗体诉说悲哀。
flavour.sourceEn:
Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows,
tipped with a poisoned hatred
only oppression can ferment.

flavour.en:
In a time of great need, surrounded by Abyssals,
the Wayward Druid came to the Sun Clan's aid.
It is a debt they have never forgotten.
flavour.zh:
深渊生物围困的危难之际，
迷途的德鲁伊向烈日部族伸出援手。
这份恩情，族人至今铭记。
flavour.sourceEn:
In a time of great need, surrounded by Abyssals,
the Wayward Druid came to the Sun Clan's aid.
It is a debt they have never forgotten.

flavour.en:
Those members of the Brotherhood who employ the venom of
Trarthan ice snakes must take great care with the volatile substance.
flavour.zh:
兄弟会的人想要使用特拉珊冰蛇之毒，
那就务必小心谨慎。
flavour.sourceEn:
Those members of the Brotherhood who employ the venom of
Trarthan ice snakes must take great care with the volatile substance.

flavour.en:
When Solaris closes her burning eye
At the end of time,
the world will perish in ice.
flavour.zh:
太阳神阖闭火瞳
时空自此告终，
世界冻亡寒冰之中。
flavour.sourceEn:
When Solaris closes her burning eye
At the end of time,
the world will perish in ice.

flavour.en: The devil finds work for idle hands.
flavour.zh: 虚度光阴之人容易走上邪道。
flavour.sourceEn: The devil finds work for idle hands.

flavour.en:
Worship of house gods was tolerated
in Oriath, so long as it remained private.
flavour.zh:
奥瑞亚容忍私下的崇拜，
只是不得将其公之于众。
flavour.sourceEn:
Worship of house gods was tolerated
in Oriath, so long as it remained private.

flavour.en:
A hearth unyielding, ever warm,
A light unbroken, endlessly reborn.
flavour.zh:
炉火不灭，温热长存。
光明不惜，复明常恒。
flavour.sourceEn:
A hearth unyielding, ever warm,
A light unbroken, endlessly reborn.

flavour.en: To stray is to condemn this world to sin.
flavour.zh: 偏离正道，便是将陷这世界于罪孽之中。
flavour.sourceEn: To stray is to condemn this world to sin.

flavour.en:
Where the body's limits begin,
the mind's limits end.
flavour.zh:
肉体决定了你的起点，
而灵魂决定了你的终点。
flavour.sourceEn:
Where the body's limits begin,
the mind's limits end.

flavour.en: Tempered by the forbidden flame.
flavour.zh: 禁断之火淬炼而出。
flavour.sourceEn: Tempered by the forbidden flame.

flavour.en:
Experiments with geomancy taught
the Maji more than they ever expected.
flavour.zh:
众贤尝试地术，
收获远超预想。
flavour.sourceEn:
Experiments with geomancy taught
the Maji more than they ever expected.

flavour.en: Beyond madness lies inspiration.
flavour.zh: 灵感埋没在疯狂的另一端。
flavour.sourceEn: Beyond madness lies inspiration.

flavour.en:
Each crest was a Thane's word, bolted to Ivor's bow.
They would join the Count's side, or die by his hands.
flavour.zh: 每一枚纹章都是一位领主的誓约，被铆接在艾沃的弓上。他们要么归顺伯爵，要么死于伯爵之手。
flavour.sourceEn:
Each crest was a Thane's word, bolted to Ivor's bow.
They would join the Count's side, or die by his hands.

flavour.en: A power unknown aids your own.
flavour.zh: 那股未知的力量也为你所用。
flavour.sourceEn: A power unknown aids your own.

flavour.en: Let the rider's aim be true.
flavour.zh: 愿骑手能百发百中。
flavour.sourceEn: Let the rider's aim be true.

flavour.en: The whispers of the old gods hum through the iron. They demand a hero.
flavour.zh: 旧神的低语在铁中嗡嗡作响。他们呼唤英雄到来。
flavour.sourceEn: The whispers of the old gods hum through the iron. They demand a hero.

flavour.en: Power is a matter of perspective.
flavour.zh: 力量也只是一种观念。
flavour.sourceEn: Power is a matter of perspective.

flavour.en: Cold, miserable and alone... but alive.
flavour.zh: 冰冷，悲惨，无人过问，但一息尚存。
flavour.sourceEn: Cold, miserable and alone... but alive.

flavour.en: The warrior who fears will fall.
flavour.zh:
勇斗之魂无坚不摧，
懦弱之心退缩避畏。
flavour.sourceEn: The warrior who fears will fall.

flavour.en:
Below all living things,
there exists a flow...
flavour.zh:
众生之下，
皆有涓流……
flavour.sourceEn:
Below all living things,
there exists a flow...

flavour.en:
The priests of the Kalguur keep faith through numbers
and calculation, not unprovable promises.
flavour.zh:
卡古兰的先师相信数字和计算，
而不是无从求证的空洞诺言。
flavour.sourceEn:
The priests of the Kalguur keep faith through numbers
and calculation, not unprovable promises.

flavour.en:
"Stitches? Wouldn't that defeat the purpose?"
- Jeffry, Torturer's Apprentice
flavour.zh:
缝起来？那不就违背本意了吗？
——杰弗里，拷问者的学徒
flavour.sourceEn:
"Stitches? Wouldn't that defeat the purpose?"
- Jeffry, Torturer's Apprentice

flavour.en: The toughest armour is the trust of your people.
flavour.zh: 信任你的人民将成为你最坚固的护具。
flavour.sourceEn: The toughest armour is the trust of your people.

flavour.en: Reality is a puzzle. Ingenuity is power.
flavour.zh: 现实如同谜题，才思乃是力量。
flavour.sourceEn: Reality is a puzzle. Ingenuity is power.

flavour.en:
"How do I cope with what I witnessed on Wraeclast?
Thank the Ancestors! My cup, it overflows."
- Lavianga, former advisor to Kaom
flavour.zh:
“我该如何面对在瓦尔克拉斯目睹的一切？
感谢先祖！我的酒杯，早已满溢。”
— 拉维安加，冈姆前任军师
flavour.sourceEn:
"How do I cope with what I witnessed on Wraeclast?
Thank the Ancestors! My cup, it overflows."
- Lavianga, former advisor to Kaom

flavour.en: For none of us are as cruel as all of us.
flavour.zh: 结群聚众必然生成力量之源。
flavour.sourceEn: For none of us are as cruel as all of us.

flavour.en: A wall of steel and muscle.
flavour.zh: 坚钢与血肉铸成了长城。
flavour.sourceEn: A wall of steel and muscle.

flavour.en: "Keep smiling. The deepest cut comes not from insults, but from false praise."
flavour.zh: “接着微笑吧。最深的伤痕并非来自侮辱，而是源于虚伪的赞美。”
flavour.sourceEn: "Keep smiling. The deepest cut comes not from insults, but from false praise."

flavour.en: Highgate held other secrets.
flavour.zh: 统治者之殿还隐藏着其他秘密。
flavour.sourceEn: Highgate held other secrets.

flavour.en:
From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.
flavour.zh:
至微者，须弥芥子
至伟者，参天神木，
无论微伟，皆可立足帝陆。
flavour.sourceEn:
From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.

flavour.en:
The world churned during the Great Wasting.
Tawhoa may have stilled the rioting earth,
but it was Valako that tamed the broken sky.
flavour.zh:
大荒废年代里，世界天翻地覆。
塔赫亚也许能安抚狂暴的大地，
但能制服破碎天穹的只有瓦拉克。
flavour.sourceEn:
The world churned during the Great Wasting.
Tawhoa may have stilled the rioting earth,
but it was Valako that tamed the broken sky.

flavour.en: Healing the soul requires sacrifice.
flavour.zh: 只有精诚奉献，才能治愈心灵。
flavour.sourceEn: Healing the soul requires sacrifice.

flavour.en:
In that moment, Viridi's bones became
branches, weaving over the Darkness.
She coiled around the nothing,
trapping it within her everything.
flavour.zh:
那一刻，维里迪的骸骨化作枝杈，
在黑暗之上编织。
她盘绕虚空，
将其困于自身的万物之中。
flavour.sourceEn:
In that moment, Viridi's bones became
branches, weaving over the Darkness.
She coiled around the nothing,
trapping it within her everything.

flavour.en:
"Kinslayer, you dishonour your own traditions to turn the tide of battle!
Let us see which is stronger... Karui savagery or the might of the Empire!"
- General Marceus Lioneye
flavour.zh:
“弑亲者，你为扭转战局，居然背弃传统！
让我们看看哪方更强……卡鲁的野性，还是帝国的力量！”
— 穆希尔斯，狮眼将军
flavour.sourceEn:
"Kinslayer, you dishonour your own traditions to turn the tide of battle!
Let us see which is stronger... Karui savagery or the might of the Empire!"
- General Marceus Lioneye

flavour.en:
Why cling to your sanity? It offers you nothing.
Surrender to me, and I will grant you everything.
flavour.zh:
迁就理智，你将一无所获，
屈服于我，你将收获丰硕。
flavour.sourceEn:
Why cling to your sanity? It offers you nothing.
Surrender to me, and I will grant you everything.

flavour.en:
The collector need not even speak. Each ring
regaled them with tales of his conquest.
flavour.zh:
收藏家甚至无需开口。
每枚戒指都向他讲述着他的征服传奇。
flavour.sourceEn:
The collector need not even speak. Each ring
regaled them with tales of his conquest.

flavour.en: Blessed are those who tend the Grove.
flavour.zh: 护林之人可蒙恩典。
flavour.sourceEn: Blessed are those who tend the Grove.

flavour.en: A true predator does not chase; It waits.
flavour.zh: 真正的狩猎者不会追逐；只会等待。
flavour.sourceEn: A true predator does not chase; It waits.

flavour.en:
Rivers of power coursed through their veins.
Now, that power is yours, for good or ill.
flavour.zh:
力量的河流曾于他们血管中奔涌。
如今，那力量属于你了——无论祸福。
flavour.sourceEn:
Rivers of power coursed through their veins.
Now, that power is yours, for good or ill.

flavour.en: The Banished Architect sought to employ the darkest secrets of the Vaal.
flavour.zh: 被放逐的建筑师试图采用最黑暗的瓦尔秘法。
flavour.sourceEn: The Banished Architect sought to employ the darkest secrets of the Vaal.

flavour.en:
Maligaro operated effortlessly,
with great speed and terrible consequences.
flavour.zh:
马雷格罗奇术出众卓越，
无比迅捷，带来无尽浩劫。
flavour.sourceEn:
Maligaro operated effortlessly,
with great speed and terrible consequences.

flavour.en:
"Drunken Erqi boasted to Tukohama; the God of War
challenged him to a clash of strength. Woe to the
Divine - he should have made it a test of skill!"
flavour.zh:
“醉汉厄尔齐跟图克哈马吹牛；
战神跟他比拼力气。倒霉的是神明
——他应该比的是技巧才对！”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Drunken Erqi boasted to Tukohama; the God of War
challenged him to a clash of strength. Woe to the
Divine - he should have made it a test of skill!"

flavour.en:
A terror of ancient times, his identity
remains lost... but his power does not.
flavour.zh:
那上古恐魔的身份无人知晓，
可他的力量并未失落。
flavour.sourceEn:
A terror of ancient times, his identity
remains lost... but his power does not.

flavour.en:
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born.
From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born.
It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.
flavour.zh:
夏巴夸亚源于众神之躯。
而我们则生于它的遗骸。
那么，归于众神自然是吾等之大限。
flavour.sourceEn:
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born.
From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born.
It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.

flavour.en: In our tales, and in our hearts, the rivers still flow.
flavour.zh: 传于故事，藏于内心，河川奔流不止。
flavour.sourceEn: In our tales, and in our hearts, the rivers still flow.

flavour.en:
If you're going to act like you're better
than everyone else, make sure you are.
flavour.zh:
如果你想表现得比所有人都强，
那最好有真本事。
flavour.sourceEn:
If you're going to act like you're better
than everyone else, make sure you are.

flavour.en:
Kaom's strength was rivaled only by
the great Meginord of the north.
flavour.zh:
冈姆的勇猛威震天下，
唯有北方的梅吉诺德能与他一较高下。
flavour.sourceEn:
Kaom's strength was rivaled only by
the great Meginord of the north.

flavour.en: What is life, but a dreamlike spiral of panic?
flavour.zh: 所谓生命，不就是噩梦般螺旋不止的恐慌吗？
flavour.sourceEn: What is life, but a dreamlike spiral of panic?

flavour.en: Lead by example, and you shall never be alone.
flavour.zh: 以身作则，就不会成为孤身陌客。
flavour.sourceEn: Lead by example, and you shall never be alone.

flavour.en:
Adversity is the soil in
which persistence grows.
flavour.zh:
以逆境为沃土，
便可培育毅力。
flavour.sourceEn:
Adversity is the soil in
which persistence grows.

flavour.en:
The sky tore asunder, black cleaving upon blue
The end of life, of Time, with no escape
But they found a fragment, a void, a haven
And there they waited, as it all began again
Dark will, dark knowledge, enemies of Fate
They know your mind, because they remember
flavour.zh:
天空撕裂，漆黑破空，
生命终结，时间终末，无处可逃。
他们却找到碎片、虚空与避所，
就在那里，等待一切再度开始。
黑暗的意志，黑暗的知识，命运的敌人：
他们知你之念，因为他们曾记得。
flavour.sourceEn:
The sky tore asunder, black cleaving upon blue
The end of life, of Time, with no escape
But they found a fragment, a void, a haven
And there they waited, as it all began again
Dark will, dark knowledge, enemies of Fate
They know your mind, because they remember

flavour.en:
Ming slew Tranquillity
Took Chaos for his wife
And on Her immortal finger
He placed his Heart
flavour.zh:
明将宁静击毙
迎娶混沌为妻
在她那不朽的细指
明戴上真心诚挚
flavour.sourceEn:
Ming slew Tranquillity
Took Chaos for his wife
And on Her immortal finger
He placed his Heart

flavour.en:
Sibilant promises surrounded them in the night.
All the travelers had to give him was their devotion...
flavour.zh:
深夜之际，细碎的承诺环绕着他们。
所有旅人只得向他献出自己的虔诚。
flavour.sourceEn:
Sibilant promises surrounded them in the night.
All the travelers had to give him was their devotion...

entries.semanticNotes: Installed ASCII spelling is matched to the source diacritic spelling, identical Torment Club base and Mjolner art identifier.

flavour.en: Look the storm in the eye and you will have its respect.
flavour.zh: 拾起此锤者，将可操控雷霆，号令风暴。
flavour.sourceEn: Look the storm in the eye and you will have its respect.

flavour.en:
The Unblinking Eye did not cower and wail.
They stood against the end.
flavour.zh:
凝望之眼绝不会退缩，
他们傲立至最后一刻。
flavour.sourceEn:
The Unblinking Eye did not cower and wail.
They stood against the end.

flavour.en:
"Boiling frogs isn't for spells, dear. That's a disgusting
rumour. They're actually for brewing poisons."
- Selassie of the Black Fen
flavour.zh:
“水煮青蛙不是为了施法，亲爱的。那是
歹毒的谣传。这其实是用来制备毒药的。”
——黑沼的瑟莱西
flavour.sourceEn:
"Boiling frogs isn't for spells, dear. That's a disgusting
rumour. They're actually for brewing poisons."
- Selassie of the Black Fen

flavour.en: The end always comes sooner than we think.
flavour.zh: 结局近在眼前，远超你我所想。
flavour.sourceEn: The end always comes sooner than we think.

flavour.en:
"Even in the face of the Winter of the World,
life found a way. The Spirit always provides."
flavour.zh:
“即使面对世界之冬，生命也能找到出路。
万灵始终都在庇佑我们。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Even in the face of the Winter of the World,
life found a way. The Spirit always provides."

flavour.en:
The first witch hunter knew one critical tactic:
never let your enemy have a clear moment.
flavour.zh:
最初的猎巫人掌握了最重要的战术：
绝不可让你的敌人获得片刻的安生。
flavour.sourceEn:
The first witch hunter knew one critical tactic:
never let your enemy have a clear moment.

flavour.en:
They hoped that, trapped in its prison,
the creature would age and perish.
But time would not touch the fiend.
flavour.zh:
人们希望，那只被困在牢狱中的怪物
会衰老死去。
但时间没有对这只恶魔造成丝毫影响。
flavour.sourceEn:
They hoped that, trapped in its prison,
the creature would age and perish.
But time would not touch the fiend.

flavour.en:
Fueled by the blackness in the hearts of men,
the armies of Saresh were just as relentless.
flavour.zh:
沙利希的无穷大军冷酷无情，
人心的黑暗助长了那份气焰。
flavour.sourceEn:
Fueled by the blackness in the hearts of men,
the armies of Saresh were just as relentless.

flavour.en: Kaom was not known for his restraint.
flavour.zh: 冈姆的英名与隐忍毫无关联。
flavour.sourceEn: Kaom was not known for his restraint.

flavour.en:
"Upon plains of endless chill,
They Who Never Tire... dominate.
They Who Never Surrender... terrify.
And They Who Lay Beneath... wait for Nightfall."
- Tul, She That Silences
flavour.zh:
“于无尽寒原之上，
永不疲倦者……主宰。
永不降者……令人生畏。
而蛰伏于下者……静候夜幕降临。”
— 托沃，止息之母
flavour.sourceEn:
"Upon plains of endless chill,
They Who Never Tire... dominate.
They Who Never Surrender... terrify.
And They Who Lay Beneath... wait for Nightfall."
- Tul, She That Silences

flavour.en: Diamora sings not for hunger, but for longing.
flavour.zh: 驱使戴娅摩菈歌唱的不是饥饿，而是渴求。
flavour.sourceEn: Diamora sings not for hunger, but for longing.

flavour.en:
Light and shadow chase eternal,
but neither knows the other exists...
flavour.zh:
光影在永恒的追逐中纠缠，
却根本不知道彼此的存在。
flavour.sourceEn:
Light and shadow chase eternal,
but neither knows the other exists...

flavour.en: Fight with the ferocity of the First Ones.
flavour.zh: 上阵搏杀的英姿，当如凶猛的初生之子。
flavour.sourceEn: Fight with the ferocity of the First Ones.

flavour.en: The druids swore to protect the Grelwood with their very lives.
flavour.zh: 德鲁伊誓言守护韧木森林，不惜生命。
flavour.sourceEn: The druids swore to protect the Grelwood with their very lives.

flavour.en: The storm cannot sway those of sure footing.
flavour.zh: 稳健之人无惧风浪。
flavour.sourceEn: The storm cannot sway those of sure footing.

flavour.en:
Olroth the Gallant,
tireless and true,
he fights for me,
he fights for you!
flavour.zh:
勇敢的欧罗什，
不知疲倦和真实，
他为我而战，
他为你而战！
flavour.sourceEn:
Olroth the Gallant,
tireless and true,
he fights for me,
he fights for you!

flavour.en:
"True heroes grow stronger in the face of adversity."
- Fourth Tenet of the Knights of the Sun
flavour.zh:
“真正的英雄面对逆境，越挫越勇。”
— 《烈阳骑士第四信条》
flavour.sourceEn:
"True heroes grow stronger in the face of adversity."
- Fourth Tenet of the Knights of the Sun

flavour.en:
"Calculations complete, and He is assembled.
Our immaculate tactics are set in motion."
flavour.zh:
“计算完毕，他已组装完成。
我们的完美战术已启动。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Calculations complete, and He is assembled.
Our immaculate tactics are set in motion."

flavour.en:
Innocence rose to godhood not on inspired faith,
but on the vilification and hatred of another.
flavour.zh:
纯净之神升格成为神灵并不是靠信仰所激发，
而是对另外一个人的诋毁和憎恨。
flavour.sourceEn:
Innocence rose to godhood not on inspired faith,
but on the vilification and hatred of another.

flavour.en:
Bloodshed on the crimson shores,
longing for the endless sea.
Treasures, life, I'd give it all
just to capture thee.
flavour.zh:
猩红海岸血战殇，
唯盼无尽之汪洋。
珍宝生命皆可献，
只求跃然笔墨间。
flavour.sourceEn:
Bloodshed on the crimson shores,
longing for the endless sea.
Treasures, life, I'd give it all
just to capture thee.

flavour.en:
"We sometimes fail. We sometimes succeed. Who determines one from the other?
I now know we can never be made One, if we are bore of differing desires.
And yet, I have hope for a new truth. And I will see it... made real."
- The Benevolent Dreamer
flavour.zh:
“我们有时失败，有时成功。谁来定义孰是孰非？
我如今明白：若我们欲合为一体，却心怀不同愿望，便永不得其所。
但我依然怀抱希望，愿这新真理……得以实现。”
— 慈爱的幻梦者
flavour.sourceEn:
"We sometimes fail. We sometimes succeed. Who determines one from the other?
I now know we can never be made One, if we are bore of differing desires.
And yet, I have hope for a new truth. And I will see it... made real."
- The Benevolent Dreamer

flavour.en:
His isolation caused him to treasure
their companionship all the more.
flavour.zh:
正是因为他向来孑然一身，
才会如此珍视他们的陪伴。
flavour.sourceEn:
His isolation caused him to treasure
their companionship all the more.

flavour.en: A pact with Prospero always comes at a price.
flavour.zh: 与普洛斯彼罗定约总要付出代价。
flavour.sourceEn: A pact with Prospero always comes at a price.

flavour.en:
The Trickster God turned the very Day and Night against each other.
What hope have you?
flavour.zh:
狡诈的天神让白昼和夜晚永世为敌，
你还能有什么指望？
flavour.sourceEn:
The Trickster God turned the very Day and Night against each other.
What hope have you?

flavour.en:
As the Maji approached the edge of Nothingness, she strung
fragments of the Wildwood's carcass together. When she
nocked her arrow, she pulled upon the elements of life itself.
flavour.zh:
当玛吉行至虚无之畔，
她将荒林残骸的碎片串联成弓。
当她搭箭上弦，她引动的便是生命本身的元素。
flavour.sourceEn:
As the Maji approached the edge of Nothingness, she strung
fragments of the Wildwood's carcass together. When she
nocked her arrow, she pulled upon the elements of life itself.

flavour.en:
Forged to rule the waves and tide
Destined to serve the monkey's paw
Strong as a tower of iron
Deft as the needle doubt
flavour.zh:
生来驾浪驭潮
命定侍从行者
若铁塔，坚韧不倒
似细针，挥动自如
flavour.sourceEn:
Forged to rule the waves and tide
Destined to serve the monkey's paw
Strong as a tower of iron
Deft as the needle doubt

flavour.en: Ulcers, scabs, and pocks, the third army makes its claim.
flavour.zh: 溃疡、痂痕和痘疹，索命无数的第三方。
flavour.sourceEn: Ulcers, scabs, and pocks, the third army makes its claim.

flavour.en:
I rule the north
A legacy earned
Time and time again
Sing Meginord's song!
flavour.zh:
我御北疆之地，
争得一世传承，
梅吉诺德之歌，
传唱千秋万代！
flavour.sourceEn:
I rule the north
A legacy earned
Time and time again
Sing Meginord's song!

flavour.en:
The combat stance used by Vaal nobles
was as elegant as it was deadly.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔贵族的战姿
优雅与致命相伴。
flavour.sourceEn:
The combat stance used by Vaal nobles
was as elegant as it was deadly.

flavour.en:
In an endless war against darkness,
one must be ever vigilant.
flavour.zh:
在对抗黑暗的无尽战争里，
每个人都要时刻警惕。
flavour.sourceEn:
In an endless war against darkness,
one must be ever vigilant.

flavour.en:
In its final era, the roofs of Keth were rife with
anything and everything that could hold water...
should the opportunity arise.
flavour.zh:
在最后的那个时代
克斯的屋顶摆满了盛水的器皿……
只求那一丝生机。
flavour.sourceEn:
In its final era, the roofs of Keth were rife with
anything and everything that could hold water...
should the opportunity arise.

flavour.en: When blood is paid, the weak think twice.
flavour.zh: 唯有弱者对挥洒鲜血感到迟疑。
flavour.sourceEn: When blood is paid, the weak think twice.

flavour.en: Entropy can be reversed.
flavour.zh: 熵灭也可逆转。
flavour.sourceEn: Entropy can be reversed.

flavour.en: Agony brings clarity to those of pure mind.
flavour.zh: 心灵纯粹之人可从痛苦中获得明晰。
flavour.sourceEn: Agony brings clarity to those of pure mind.

flavour.en: As the serpent wills.
flavour.zh: 腾蛇之愿必将实现。
flavour.sourceEn: As the serpent wills.

flavour.en:
"The finest prosperity grows from the direst
carnage. Such is the nature of progress."
- Doryani of the Vaal
flavour.zh:
“富贵总是险中求，
但财货乃身外之物，哪会问去留。”
——瓦尔族多里亚尼
flavour.sourceEn:
"The finest prosperity grows from the direst
carnage. Such is the nature of progress."
- Doryani of the Vaal

flavour.en:
Shedding away her regal past,
she forged a new destiny.
Sacrificing the ephemeral joys of man,
she embraced the eternal grasp of nature.
Seizing her one true wish,
she found peace at last.
flavour.zh:
他人抚慰，仅得苦痛暂缓，
回归自然，方是永恒终站。
flavour.sourceEn:
Shedding away her regal past,
she forged a new destiny.
Sacrificing the ephemeral joys of man,
she embraced the eternal grasp of nature.
Seizing her one true wish,
she found peace at last.

flavour.en:
"The rain of a thousand quills that whittle
present into past, life into death."
- Rigwald of the Ezomytes
flavour.zh:
“万矢齐发，战事皆往，生者皆亡。”
——艾兹麦人瑞佛
flavour.sourceEn:
"The rain of a thousand quills that whittle
present into past, life into death."
- Rigwald of the Ezomytes

flavour.en: No man burns alone.
flavour.zh: 行于烈火之人并不孤独。
flavour.sourceEn: No man burns alone.

flavour.en:
"His approach to the gate was met with sounding trumpets
and an unfurling of banners. He never saw it coming."
- anonymous Brotherhood of Silence report
flavour.zh:
“他来到大门前，只闻嘹亮的号角
只见舒展的旌旗，令他始料不及。”
— 不知其名的寂静联盟报告
flavour.sourceEn:
"His approach to the gate was met with sounding trumpets
and an unfurling of banners. He never saw it coming."
- anonymous Brotherhood of Silence report

flavour.en:
The Vaal emptied their slaves of beating hearts,
and left a mountain of twitching dead.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔帝国建立在无数人的血汗之上，
为之付出的人们如今却已化为尘埃。
flavour.sourceEn:
The Vaal emptied their slaves of beating hearts,
and left a mountain of twitching dead.

flavour.en:
"It's a rare man that has eyes in the back of his head."
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
flavour.zh:
“很少人能像背后生出双眼一般地感应空气的流动。”
——瓦尔箭术师奇拉维
flavour.sourceEn:
"It's a rare man that has eyes in the back of his head."
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer

flavour.en: Blood shed is blood shared.
flavour.zh: 流血等同分享血液。
flavour.sourceEn: Blood shed is blood shared.

flavour.en:
"The time has passed for diplomacy!
If they will not respect House Azadi,
then let them die gloriously... and loudly.
We are the masters of the Death Trades!"
- Ratha Azadi
flavour.zh:
“外交的时代已经过去！
如果阿扎迪家族得不到尊重，
那就让他们光荣而响亮地赴死。
我们是亡命买卖的大师！”
— 拉莎·阿扎迪
flavour.sourceEn:
"The time has passed for diplomacy!
If they will not respect House Azadi,
then let them die gloriously... and loudly.
We are the masters of the Death Trades!"
- Ratha Azadi

flavour.en: In all things, control.
flavour.zh: 万事万物，皆有掌控。
flavour.sourceEn: In all things, control.

flavour.en: The sacred sap flows slowly, but surely.
flavour.zh: 纯洁的树脂缓缓流动。
flavour.sourceEn: The sacred sap flows slowly, but surely.

flavour.en:
"Do not despair! Give yourself to the woods!
Become empty, and the Goddess will find you.
From within her roots... you shall be restored."
- Cirel of Caer Tarth
flavour.zh:
“不要绝望！将你自己献给森林！
变得空无，女神便会找到你。
在她的根须之中……你将被恢复。”
——赛尔塔斯的西雷尔
flavour.sourceEn:
"Do not despair! Give yourself to the woods!
Become empty, and the Goddess will find you.
From within her roots... you shall be restored."
- Cirel of Caer Tarth

flavour.en:
My bearer shall be guarded by flame,
for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.
flavour.zh:
持此护盾，圣火护卫，
吾乃凤凰，光灿永辉。
flavour.sourceEn:
My bearer shall be guarded by flame,
for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.

flavour.en:
To become a warrior and a hunter, each young
Azmeri must prove themselves before the Spirit.
flavour.zh:
要想成为战士和猎手，每个年轻的
阿兹莫里人都必须在万灵面前证明自己。
flavour.sourceEn:
To become a warrior and a hunter, each young
Azmeri must prove themselves before the Spirit.

flavour.en:
"Resist for long enough, and your oppressor
will lose his will. Then, you've won."
flavour.zh:
“只要坚持抵抗，暴君终会灰心。
那便是胜利的日子。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Resist for long enough, and your oppressor
will lose his will. Then, you've won."

flavour.en:
Fanatics are the most dangerous enemy,
for they care not for their own survival.
flavour.zh:
狂热之人最为危险，
他们早已枉顾安危。
flavour.sourceEn:
Fanatics are the most dangerous enemy,
for they care not for their own survival.

flavour.en:
Smithed from ancient metal
wrought from the very stars.
It is a means to call upon them,
for one capable of wielding it.
flavour.zh:
“来自星辰之体，
锻自远古金属。
这是召唤群星的秘术，
唯有能者才能使用。”
flavour.sourceEn:
Smithed from ancient metal
wrought from the very stars.
It is a means to call upon them,
for one capable of wielding it.

flavour.en: All creatures have the potential for greatness or unequivocal failure.
flavour.zh: 所有生物都有干成大事或是贻笑大方的潜质。
flavour.sourceEn: All creatures have the potential for greatness or unequivocal failure.

flavour.en:
Fire destroys, but fire also purifies.
Life always springs anew.
flavour.zh:
烈火带来破坏，火焰送来净化，
生命也将孕育一新。
flavour.sourceEn:
Fire destroys, but fire also purifies.
Life always springs anew.

flavour.en:
The Twilight Order rejected the gods, choosing
instead to put their faith in each other.
flavour.zh:
暮光会拒绝侍奉神明，
选择将信仰赋予彼此。
flavour.sourceEn:
The Twilight Order rejected the gods, choosing
instead to put their faith in each other.

flavour.en:
"You mortals are insidious. You repress your
evil, or deny it exists. Liars! When I open
your heads, that violence floods out."
- The Raven Trickster
flavour.zh:
“凡人真是阴险。
要么压抑内心的邪恶，要么否认它的存在。一群骗子！
等我打开你们的脑袋，那暴力便会奔涌而出。”
— 黑鸦欺诈者
flavour.sourceEn:
"You mortals are insidious. You repress your
evil, or deny it exists. Liars! When I open
your heads, that violence floods out."
- The Raven Trickster

flavour.en: A swift mind solves problems before they occur.
flavour.zh: 机智心灵总能预测危难。
flavour.sourceEn: A swift mind solves problems before they occur.

flavour.en:
The Vaal protected those who integrated into their
culture. Many neighbours became one. Sekhema Safrin
vowed the Maraketh identity would remain resolute.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔接纳了那些融入其文化的人。
众多邻邦与之合为一体。丝克玛·萨芙琳
誓言马拉克斯人的身份将坚如磐石。
flavour.sourceEn:
The Vaal protected those who integrated into their
culture. Many neighbours became one. Sekhema Safrin
vowed the Maraketh identity would remain resolute.

flavour.en:
Born in a star of man's own make,
fused to her hand by her last mistake.
flavour.zh:
诞生于人造的星辰，
因她最后的错误而与手相融。
flavour.sourceEn:
Born in a star of man's own make,
fused to her hand by her last mistake.

flavour.en: The desert is ever flowing.
flavour.zh: 沙海奔流，从不停歇。
flavour.sourceEn: The desert is ever flowing.

flavour.en: A fell wind brings death.
flavour.zh: 陨落之风带来死亡。
flavour.sourceEn: A fell wind brings death.

flavour.en: One way or another, it will find what it seeks.
flavour.zh: 不论如何，它终会找到目标。
flavour.sourceEn: One way or another, it will find what it seeks.

flavour.en:
Wraeclast has known too few true heroes.
It remembers those that stood in defiance.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔克拉斯从未出过如此多的英雄豪杰。
这里会铭记那些敢于奋起反抗的勇者。
flavour.sourceEn:
Wraeclast has known too few true heroes.
It remembers those that stood in defiance.

flavour.en:
"The sharper the pain, the sharper the mind.
A curious paradox."
- Shavronne of Umbra
flavour.zh:
“肉体的苦痛换来清晰的脑袋。
真是个有趣的悖论。”
——黑影薛朗
flavour.sourceEn:
"The sharper the pain, the sharper the mind.
A curious paradox."
- Shavronne of Umbra

flavour.en:
The Abyssals were created, not born,
and every moment in the light was agony.
flavour.zh:
深渊之物并非自然诞生，而是外力创造。
在光明之中的每一刻，都将是痛苦煎熬。
flavour.sourceEn:
The Abyssals were created, not born,
and every moment in the light was agony.

flavour.en: The dawn of a new era is set into motion
flavour.zh: 新时代的黎明已经降临了
flavour.sourceEn: The dawn of a new era is set into motion

flavour.en: Within lies a window.
flavour.zh: 它的深处潜伏着暗影。
flavour.sourceEn: Within lies a window.

flavour.en: Within lies a window.
flavour.zh: 它的深处潜伏着暗影。
flavour.sourceEn: Within lies a window.

flavour.en:
A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night
after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination.
Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.
flavour.zh:
一个平民出身的普通士兵，每次残酷行军后
依然在深夜苦练，双眼燃烧着星火般的决心。
没人料到他日后会成为众人之中的传奇。
flavour.sourceEn:
A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night
after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination.
Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.

flavour.en:
When Kabala the Serpent Queen was banished from Keth,
the Sekhemas took a single hostage as punishment.
flavour.zh:
毒蛇女王卡芭菈被逐出了克斯，
众丝克玛仅仅质押了一名人质。
flavour.sourceEn:
When Kabala the Serpent Queen was banished from Keth,
the Sekhemas took a single hostage as punishment.

flavour.en: Sinuous, entwined... inextricable.
flavour.zh: 蜿蜒盘曲，百转千回……难解难分。
flavour.sourceEn: Sinuous, entwined... inextricable.

flavour.en: Captivity breeds creativity.
flavour.zh: 对自由的渴望会造就无穷的希望。
flavour.sourceEn: Captivity breeds creativity.

flavour.en:
"Captain Hiff Greybeard accomplished what nary a Brinerot
could: he died of old age. Almost had him a dozen times
meself, if it weren't for that damn leg of his... crafty shite..."
flavour.zh:
“希夫·灰胡子船长做到了布琳洛特人永远做不到的事：
自然老死。我差点亲自弄死他十几回，
全怪他那条该死的腿……狡猾的老东西”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Captain Hiff Greybeard accomplished what nary a Brinerot
could: he died of old age. Almost had him a dozen times
meself, if it weren't for that damn leg of his... crafty shite..."

flavour.en: Bring mystery to life. Again and again.
flavour.zh: 一次又一次，令生命萌生谜团。
flavour.sourceEn: Bring mystery to life. Again and again.

flavour.en: Be not deceived by the treachery of men.
flavour.zh: 莫被人之诡诈所欺。
flavour.sourceEn: Be not deceived by the treachery of men.

flavour.en:
Born among the high peaks, many Mutewind
live their entire lives in snow and ice.
flavour.zh:
许多哑风成员诞生于群峰之间，
终此一生都在冰天雪地中跋涉。
flavour.sourceEn:
Born among the high peaks, many Mutewind
live their entire lives in snow and ice.

flavour.en:
Hallowed Dordalus was cast into the pit as a heretic,
but his piety was so great, he would not burn.
He rose again, lauded, his faith forever changed...
but not the way the Templar believed.
flavour.zh:
圣徒多达鲁斯被判作异端，抛入坑中，
可虔诚之心昭然，罪火无法伤其分毫。
他挺身而起，高声赞颂，信仰不曾移……
圣堂武僧却不愿相信。
flavour.sourceEn:
Hallowed Dordalus was cast into the pit as a heretic,
but his piety was so great, he would not burn.
He rose again, lauded, his faith forever changed...
but not the way the Templar believed.

flavour.en:
As a boy, in the arena, Daresso learned to
feign weakness to open up a lethal blow.
flavour.zh:
青年的德瑞索踏上了竞技场，
学会了示敌以弱，扮猪吃虎。
flavour.sourceEn:
As a boy, in the arena, Daresso learned to
feign weakness to open up a lethal blow.

flavour.en: The greatest warrior of his era fought with honour.
flavour.zh: 那时代最伟大的战士都心怀荣耀。
flavour.sourceEn: The greatest warrior of his era fought with honour.

flavour.en: That which was broken may yet break.
flavour.zh: 往昔战败遭破，来日亦可破敌。
flavour.sourceEn: That which was broken may yet break.

flavour.en:
We happily give our limbs.
A net woven to keep safe the bones of the Lords.
flavour.zh:
献上我们的身躯，
捍卫领主的遗产。
flavour.sourceEn:
We happily give our limbs.
A net woven to keep safe the bones of the Lords.

flavour.en: Heads fall to the sand, just as the star fell from the sky
flavour.zh: 首级滚落杀害，星辰坠落天际。
flavour.sourceEn: Heads fall to the sand, just as the star fell from the sky

flavour.en: A hundred blind heads, each seeking the taste of prey on the air.
flavour.zh: 血肉的气味弥漫于空气中。
flavour.sourceEn: A hundred blind heads, each seeking the taste of prey on the air.

flavour.en:
As the serpent shuns thought,
It shuns fear.
It strikes with the speed of wrath
And the skill of compulsion.
flavour.zh:
当巨蛇不再多虑，
它变得无所畏惧。
愤恨难平，迅速杀敌！
展现气血狂怒的战技。
flavour.sourceEn:
As the serpent shuns thought,
It shuns fear.
It strikes with the speed of wrath
And the skill of compulsion.

flavour.en: They wrap around you until your blood turns as cold as theirs.
flavour.zh: 用鲜血灌溉它，让它的残暴更加的嗜血。
flavour.sourceEn: They wrap around you until your blood turns as cold as theirs.

flavour.en: One warrior alone survived to face the Arbiter.
flavour.zh: 只有一个幸存的战士与仲裁官交锋。
flavour.sourceEn: One warrior alone survived to face the Arbiter.

flavour.en:
The greatest mistakes cause suffering
long after they have been made
flavour.zh:
最严重之过犯，让人吃苦受难。
即使事过境迁，依然阴魂不散。
flavour.sourceEn:
The greatest mistakes cause suffering
long after they have been made

flavour.en:
Vaal bloodpriests were among the earliest intellectuals on record.
It was they who found that a newly freed soul would
desperately cling to any other source of life.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔赤红先师是史料可考的最早的知识分子。
他们最先发现刚脱离的躯壳之灵会不顾一切地附身在其他生命形式上。
flavour.sourceEn:
