Vaal bloodpriests were among the earliest intellectuals on record.
It was they who found that a newly freed soul would
desperately cling to any other source of life.

flavour.en:
The spear was specially forged to assassinate Voll,
but Maligaro never got a chance to use it...
flavour.zh:
这把长矛是为了行刺福尔而专门打造的，
但马雷格罗从未有过动手的机会……
flavour.sourceEn:
The spear was specially forged to assassinate Voll,
but Maligaro never got a chance to use it...

flavour.en:
If you see the blushing tree of the northern woods,
remember: "Blossoms of red, the tree's been fed.
Blossoms of white, prepare for a fight."
flavour.zh:
若你见北方林间那羞红之树，
请谨记：“红花绽放，树已饱餐；
白花绽放，迎战莫缓。”
flavour.sourceEn:
If you see the blushing tree of the northern woods,
remember: "Blossoms of red, the tree's been fed.
Blossoms of white, prepare for a fight."

flavour.en: The Baleful Gem's corruption lingers still...
flavour.zh: 邪影宝石的腐化仍在继续……
flavour.sourceEn: The Baleful Gem's corruption lingers still...

flavour.en:
The forests of the Vastiri held many secrets
mystical and dark. Men learned not to wander,
lest they return with a strange new purpose.
flavour.zh:
瓦斯提里的森林隐藏着许多奥妙
神秘与黑暗令人们不愿踏入其中，
以免回归之时肩负起奇异的使命。
flavour.sourceEn:
The forests of the Vastiri held many secrets
mystical and dark. Men learned not to wander,
lest they return with a strange new purpose.

flavour.en:
"Try on another life. See how it fits. You'll
find that your one life is utterly inadequate."
- He of Many Names and Many Faces
flavour.zh:
“试试另一种人生。看看合不合身。
你会发现，你仅有一次的人生根本不够用。”
— 千面千名者
flavour.sourceEn:
"Try on another life. See how it fits. You'll
find that your one life is utterly inadequate."
- He of Many Names and Many Faces

flavour.en:
There was no hero made out of Starkonja's death,
but merely a long sleep made eternal.
flavour.zh:
斯塔空加死去，并未造就英雄豪杰，
只是永远长眠冥界。
flavour.sourceEn:
There was no hero made out of Starkonja's death,
but merely a long sleep made eternal.

flavour.en:
You are slow, foolish and ignorant.
I am not.
flavour.zh:
众人迟钝昏庸，愚昧无知。
唯我迅捷聪颖，博学睿智。
flavour.sourceEn:
You are slow, foolish and ignorant.
I am not.

flavour.en:
There is no light at the end of this inner strife,
but the shadows eventually become home.
flavour.zh:
内心的纠葛看不到尽头，
但暗影终将在此处扎根。
flavour.sourceEn:
There is no light at the end of this inner strife,
but the shadows eventually become home.

flavour.en:
"Lundara held back the hordes, while Solerai rose to split the sky.
With a single stroke, she ended the Winter of the World."
- Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara
flavour.zh:
“兰拉阻挡众人之际，索瑞腾空击碎了天穹。
凭此一击，世界之冬终于走到了尽头。”
——乌兰嘉，瓦希达阿卡拉的说书人
flavour.sourceEn:
"Lundara held back the hordes, while Solerai rose to split the sky.
With a single stroke, she ended the Winter of the World."
- Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara

flavour.en: Natural grace is born, not earned.
flavour.zh: 自然的恩赐源于天赋，而非争取。
flavour.sourceEn: Natural grace is born, not earned.

flavour.en:
"A traditional hatungo does not carry an axe,
it is true. But as Narumoa showed us, there
are many ways to crush one's enemy..."
flavour.zh:
"传统的哈图纳格斯确实不持战斧，
但正如纳鲁摩奥所展示的——
击溃敌人的方式……从来不止一种。"
flavour.sourceEn:
"A traditional hatungo does not carry an axe,
it is true. But as Narumoa showed us, there
are many ways to crush one's enemy..."

flavour.en:
The priests found the Great Shield the night it fell to Middengard,
but it was the smiths who delved into the secrets it held.
flavour.zh:
巨盾坠入米登加德，当夜便入先师之手，
但深究其中奥妙的却是那些匠人。
flavour.sourceEn:
The priests found the Great Shield the night it fell to Middengard,
but it was the smiths who delved into the secrets it held.

flavour.en:
Darkness howls through ancient bones, a wistful cry
on hollow winds. The moon listens. The pack gathers.
flavour.zh:
黑暗呼啸于古骸之间，是空穴之风里怅然的悲鸣。
明月倾听。狼群啸聚。
flavour.sourceEn:
Darkness howls through ancient bones, a wistful cry
on hollow winds. The moon listens. The pack gathers.

flavour.en:
"In the hands of Orbala, it made a god bleed."
- Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara
flavour.zh:
“在欧巴拉手中，它曾令真神流血。”
— 乌兰嘉，瓦希达阿卡拉的说书人
flavour.sourceEn:
"In the hands of Orbala, it made a god bleed."
- Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara

flavour.en:
Shed by the winged beast of night,
A scaly frost-encrusted thorn.
All who feel its wintry light
Shiver in pain at the frozen dawn.
flavour.zh:
带翼野兽在夜里脱胎换骨，
蜕下寒霜覆盖的带麟犄角。
众人感受到凛冬寒光冷酷，
无不浑身颤抖，凄厉尖啸。
flavour.sourceEn:
Shed by the winged beast of night,
A scaly frost-encrusted thorn.
All who feel its wintry light
Shiver in pain at the frozen dawn.

flavour.en:
The final element the tale-women
mastered was Time itself.
flavour.zh:
说书人最后掌握的元素
乃是时光本身。
flavour.sourceEn:
The final element the tale-women
mastered was Time itself.

flavour.en: A faith born of flesh.
flavour.zh: 诞生自肉体凡胎的一缕信念。
flavour.sourceEn: A faith born of flesh.

flavour.en:
At their height, the Vaal glittered under the sun.
A decade, a century, an aeon of prosperity...
now nothing more than a passing wonder.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔至盛年代，沐艳阳而烁金辉。
昌荣十年百年，绵延至千秋万代……
如今追思奇迹，都只是过眼云烟。
flavour.sourceEn:
At their height, the Vaal glittered under the sun.
A decade, a century, an aeon of prosperity...
now nothing more than a passing wonder.

flavour.en: Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of Faith.
flavour.zh: 让那信仰的铁砧将你无比的毅力千锤百炼。
flavour.sourceEn: Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of Faith.

flavour.en:
"The boy is a bad omen," he cried. "Ravens gather
before him!" That night, a new raven appeared, and
shadowed the Auspex for the rest of his days.
flavour.zh: “这孩子是个不祥之兆，”他哭喊道，“乌鸦在他面前集结！”当晚，一只新乌鸦出现了，并在余生中一直跟随着那位占星者。
flavour.sourceEn:
"The boy is a bad omen," he cried. "Ravens gather
before him!" That night, a new raven appeared, and
shadowed the Auspex for the rest of his days.

flavour.en:
In the mists they dwell,
forever hungry,
forever cold.
flavour.zh:
它们深居于迷雾中，
永远饥肠辘辘，
永远阴冷相随。
flavour.sourceEn:
In the mists they dwell,
forever hungry,
forever cold.

flavour.en:
The most beloved member of every Brinerot crew
is the one that refuses to do any actual work.
flavour.zh:
在布琳洛特的每艘船上，
最讨人喜爱的家伙都是从不干活儿的那个。
flavour.sourceEn:
The most beloved member of every Brinerot crew
is the one that refuses to do any actual work.

flavour.en: Suspicion is a sinister shadow slithering in the soul.
flavour.zh: 猜忌如同邪影，深伏人之内心。
flavour.sourceEn: Suspicion is a sinister shadow slithering in the soul.

flavour.en:
Brinerot pirates live in a perpetual blaze of glory,
pushing their luck right to the end.
flavour.zh:
布琳洛特的海盗永远在追逐荣耀。
并将自己的好运挥霍一空。
flavour.sourceEn:
Brinerot pirates live in a perpetual blaze of glory,
pushing their luck right to the end.

flavour.en: Touch not the thorn, for only blood and pain await.
flavour.zh:
手中所触荆棘之外，
满溢鲜血苦痛不断。
flavour.sourceEn: Touch not the thorn, for only blood and pain await.

flavour.en: The turtle's shell one day becomes its tomb.
flavour.zh: 保护乌龟的龟壳同时也是它的棺材。
flavour.sourceEn: The turtle's shell one day becomes its tomb.

flavour.en:
"What lies beneath your feet?!"
"Sacred ground, watered with tears of blood!"
flavour.zh:
“汝足下所踏何处？”
“此乃血泪浇灌之圣地。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"What lies beneath your feet?!"
"Sacred ground, watered with tears of blood!"

flavour.en:
Nothingness is loathe to relinquish its grip.
Every moment is a struggle to exist.
flavour.zh:
虚无不肯罢休，不愿放手。
每时每刻皆为存在而抗争。
flavour.sourceEn:
Nothingness is loathe to relinquish its grip.
Every moment is a struggle to exist.

flavour.en:
It coils deeper and deeper
It slithers between thoughts
It lies beneath the valley
It lies in our minds
flavour.zh:
它越钻越深，
在思绪中蠕行，
安睡在山谷中，
沉眠在心里
flavour.sourceEn:
It coils deeper and deeper
It slithers between thoughts
It lies beneath the valley
It lies in our minds

flavour.en:
Whiff of cold, tiny spark, faintest flicker in the dark.
Embers swirl, ice takes form, sky exposed - Death's perfect storm.
Frost and thunder, flames shine bright, ruin walks the land tonight.
By your hand they dance and bend, wield them and brook no end.
flavour.zh:
寒冷气息，渺小火光，黑暗中额外明亮
余火旋转，冰霜自燃，死亡风暴转瞬就到
霜与雷，火与光，今夜将陆地燃成荒
你手中，皆臣服，征服战火愿天不亮
flavour.sourceEn:
Whiff of cold, tiny spark, faintest flicker in the dark.
Embers swirl, ice takes form, sky exposed - Death's perfect storm.
Frost and thunder, flames shine bright, ruin walks the land tonight.
By your hand they dance and bend, wield them and brook no end.

flavour.en:
My Soul is your Strength
My Price is your Blood
flavour.zh:
我的灵魂将引导你勇闯天涯，
但是必须以鲜血做为代价。
flavour.sourceEn:
My Soul is your Strength
My Price is your Blood

flavour.en: Be not where death falls.
flavour.zh: 莫与死神同路。
flavour.sourceEn: Be not where death falls.

flavour.en:
Rare is the Necromancer who leads
his undead armies from the front.
flavour.zh:
少有死灵法师立于阵前，
亲率亡者大军冲锋陷阵。
flavour.sourceEn:
Rare is the Necromancer who leads
his undead armies from the front.

flavour.en: Death crawls in darkness, closer than we think.
flavour.zh: 死亡潜于黑暗，近在你我身旁。
flavour.sourceEn: Death crawls in darkness, closer than we think.

flavour.en: The spirit hungers for the flesh.
flavour.zh: 灵魂渴盼重获血肉。
flavour.sourceEn: The spirit hungers for the flesh.

flavour.en: Secrecy and silence are powers all their own.
flavour.zh: 守秘和沉默自有其力量。
flavour.sourceEn: Secrecy and silence are powers all their own.

flavour.en:
A flash of blue, a stormcloud's kiss,
her motionless dance the pulse of bliss
flavour.zh:
闪过的碧影，雷云的亲吻，
她静止的舞步中脉动着喜悦
flavour.sourceEn:
A flash of blue, a stormcloud's kiss,
her motionless dance the pulse of bliss

flavour.en:
What they saw was what they believed, and
they believed Lunaris had not abandoned them.
flavour.zh:
相信的一切映射在他们眼前，
他们相信月影不会抛弃他们。
flavour.sourceEn:
What they saw was what they believed, and
they believed Lunaris had not abandoned them.

flavour.en:
"When the headsman's blade swings,
your last moments stretch to eternity."
- Vorm, the Twice-Pardoned
flavour.zh:
“处刑者挥起大刀之时，
最后一刻便永远定格。”
——被特赦两次的沃尔姆
flavour.sourceEn:
"When the headsman's blade swings,
your last moments stretch to eternity."
- Vorm, the Twice-Pardoned

flavour.en:
"I will never forget. I will carry your memory
forward, all of you, from this ghastly Vale."
- Artair, last survivor of the Ogham rebellion
flavour.zh:
“我绝不会忘记。我会背负你们的回忆，
带你们每一个人，走出这该死的谷地。”
— 阿泰尔，欧甘义军的最后幸存者
flavour.sourceEn:
"I will never forget. I will carry your memory
forward, all of you, from this ghastly Vale."
- Artair, last survivor of the Ogham rebellion

flavour.en:
Long ago, the witches of the Azak Tribe learned
how to tap into the flow of Vivid lifeforce to
'cooperate' with their enemies... forcefully.
flavour.zh:
昔日，阿扎卡部落的女巫们掌握了
驾驭鲜活命能流的方法，
以此与敌人进行“合作”——强制合作。
flavour.sourceEn:
Long ago, the witches of the Azak Tribe learned
how to tap into the flow of Vivid lifeforce to
'cooperate' with their enemies... forcefully.

flavour.en:
"Ghorr knows only hunger, only ravenous feasting.
It will consume all that lives, and more!"
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page fourteen
flavour.zh:
“咕尔欲壑难填，一心纵情饕餮。
它将吞噬所有生灵，乃至万物！”
— 圣堂囚犯的胡言，第十四页
flavour.sourceEn:
"Ghorr knows only hunger, only ravenous feasting.
It will consume all that lives, and more!"
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page fourteen

flavour.en:
The secret Order endured by publicly
praying however the Templars demanded.
One day, justice would fall upon them...
flavour.zh:
暮光会对圣堂教团逆来顺受
以公开祈祷换得了一线生机。
而总有一天，制裁必将降临。
flavour.sourceEn:
The secret Order endured by publicly
praying however the Templars demanded.
One day, justice would fall upon them...

flavour.en: The roots burrow deeper, unveiling the wood's bounty...
flavour.zh: 根须深扎，尽显林木之丰饶……
flavour.sourceEn: The roots burrow deeper, unveiling the wood's bounty...

flavour.en: We move to be closer to her, but the distance yet grows.
flavour.zh: 我们亦步亦趋，却是渐行渐远。
flavour.sourceEn: We move to be closer to her, but the distance yet grows.

flavour.en: Some search forever for their path.
flavour.zh: 有些人永远在寻找自己的道路。
flavour.sourceEn: Some search forever for their path.

flavour.en:
"And here we shall remain...
trapped in our symphony of eternal anguish.
Artist and Composer, their fates entwined for all of time."
- Adamantia Brektov, the Composer
flavour.zh:
“我们将永远在此留驻……
由永恒苦痛的交响困缚。
画师与作曲者，两者命运自此缠纠。”
— 阿达曼缇娅·布雷克托夫，作曲家
flavour.sourceEn:
"And here we shall remain...
trapped in our symphony of eternal anguish.
Artist and Composer, their fates entwined for all of time."
- Adamantia Brektov, the Composer

flavour.en: Life and death ooze from the same sap.
flavour.zh: 生死同源，承自一脉。
flavour.sourceEn: Life and death ooze from the same sap.

flavour.en:
Through every great purge, and every fiery inquisition,
the Twilight Order endured in secret.
flavour.zh:
熬过净化，避过审讯，
暮光会仍在悄然扩张。
flavour.sourceEn:
Through every great purge, and every fiery inquisition,
the Twilight Order endured in secret.

flavour.en: May the Lightless drown in the violence of His devotion.
flavour.zh: 愿暗光者沉溺于祂那暴烈的虔信之中。
flavour.sourceEn: May the Lightless drown in the violence of His devotion.

flavour.en:
A single moment sets in motion an eternal fall,
beneath which all are buried.
flavour.zh:
剎那便能造就无尽毁坏，
一切将受掩埋。
flavour.sourceEn:
A single moment sets in motion an eternal fall,
beneath which all are buried.

flavour.en:
Only once did Maligaro wonder if he'd gone too far.
His greatest success took three entire legions to capture.
flavour.zh:
这是仅有的一次，连马雷格罗都怀疑自己是否太过分了。
他至高的杰作耗费了整整三个军团来追捕。
flavour.sourceEn:
Only once did Maligaro wonder if he'd gone too far.
His greatest success took three entire legions to capture.

flavour.en:
The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around.
Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
flavour.zh:
每个人的背后都藏着一份真实，
只要你挖的够深。
坦白都藏于那真实的最深处。
flavour.sourceEn:
The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around.
Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.

flavour.en:
"Where the boy went, ravens gathered,
feasting on misery. His vile influence
spread, swift as the carnage they wrought."
flavour.zh:
“男孩所至，乌鸦云集，
以悲苦为宴。他那恶毒的侵染蔓延，
迅如彼等造就的屠戮。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Where the boy went, ravens gathered,
feasting on misery. His vile influence
spread, swift as the carnage they wrought."

flavour.en:
That most legendary caravan bandit had
one rule: never let them see you flinch.
flavour.zh:
传奇匪王有一条规矩：
可以胆怯，不能露怯。
flavour.sourceEn:
That most legendary caravan bandit had
one rule: never let them see you flinch.

flavour.en:
Burn to cinders, scar and maim,
Rule a world, bathed in flame.
flavour.zh:
燃为灰烬，崩裂焚解；
斯是霸权，立于火焰。
flavour.sourceEn:
Burn to cinders, scar and maim,
Rule a world, bathed in flame.

flavour.en:
The night Draven attacked,
Erian was asleep at his post.
flavour.zh:
阿里安放哨偷懒的那一晚，
正是德莱文来袭的那一夜。
flavour.sourceEn:
The night Draven attacked,
Erian was asleep at his post.

flavour.en:
He never spoke a word. His opponents imagined
their own personal mockeries, most cruel.
flavour.zh:
他从不言语，对手却想象到，
那是最残酷、最刻薄的嘲弄。
flavour.sourceEn:
He never spoke a word. His opponents imagined
their own personal mockeries, most cruel.

flavour.en:
"What are you lot looking at? We're
under fire! Get to your stations!"
- Captain Sventura, the Unlucky
flavour.zh:
“你们这帮家伙在看什么？我们正在被炮击！各就各位！”
— 斯文图拉，倒霉的船长
flavour.sourceEn:
"What are you lot looking at? We're
under fire! Get to your stations!"
- Captain Sventura, the Unlucky

flavour.en:
Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.
flavour.zh:
身体沉默了内心，
因此我们舍去肉体。
flavour.sourceEn:
Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.

flavour.en:
Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.
flavour.zh:
身体沉默了内心，
因此我们舍去肉体。
flavour.sourceEn:
Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.

flavour.en:
"Moon after moon did Berek make fools
Of the great and Untamed Three
Until malice for a Brother
Slew the hatred of the Other
And Berek did hunt
Alone and free."
- Berek and the Untamed
flavour.zh:
“贝雷克拥有无比机智，
从他和抗驯者之间的缠斗便可得知。
他让那三种元素互相角力，
直到它们露出败迹，
接着一鼓作气
让自己和恶梦远离。”
——贝雷克及抗驯者
flavour.sourceEn:
"Moon after moon did Berek make fools
Of the great and Untamed Three
Until malice for a Brother
Slew the hatred of the Other
And Berek did hunt
Alone and free."
- Berek and the Untamed

flavour.en:
"The ice seared his naked feet
As the lightning stilled his heart,
But it was the flames upon his lover's face
That roused him to vengeance."
- From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn
flavour.zh:
冰霜严寒，他的赤足伤痕布满，
雷霆万钧，他的心念无法动弹，
恶火猛烈，情人容颜化为飞灰，
此时他才终于奋起复仇，猛攻不退。
——萨恩的维多里奥著作"猎龙记"
flavour.sourceEn:
"The ice seared his naked feet
As the lightning stilled his heart,
But it was the flames upon his lover's face
That roused him to vengeance."
- From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn

flavour.en:
In ghastly pits beneath the world,
Kulemak grows countless new bodies,
each more powerful than the last.
Not all of his abominations survive.
flavour.zh:
在世界深处那些可怖的深坑中，
库勒马克孕育着数不清的新躯体，
一具比一具强悍。
他造出的怪物并不都能活下来。
flavour.sourceEn:
In ghastly pits beneath the world,
Kulemak grows countless new bodies,
each more powerful than the last.
Not all of his abominations survive.

flavour.en:
His latent potential unleashed itself, a beast
bursting from its shackles. Each strike of Farrow's
hammer rang out a song for the First Ones.
flavour.zh: 他的潜能骤然释放，仿若挣脱枷锁的野兽。法罗的每一记锤击，都为初生之子奏响战歌。
flavour.sourceEn:
His latent potential unleashed itself, a beast
bursting from its shackles. Each strike of Farrow's
hammer rang out a song for the First Ones.

flavour.en:
"A queen should be seen, admired, but never touched."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
flavour.zh:
“女王者，可敬观崇拜而不可亵玩焉。”
——瓦尔女王阿兹里
flavour.sourceEn:
"A queen should be seen, admired, but never touched."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal

flavour.en: Familiarity breeds contempt.
flavour.zh: 熟门熟路会令你疏忽大意。
flavour.sourceEn: Familiarity breeds contempt.

flavour.en: Some stories are never told.
flavour.zh: 总有一些未曾言说的故事。
flavour.sourceEn: Some stories are never told.

flavour.en:
"From what beast you derived, we can only fathom.
Aye, you of living ice, rotting gill, and untold nightmare!
We Brinerot return ye to the sea."
- Weylam Roth
flavour.zh:
“你的亲族是何等兽物？我们猜测不得。
诚然，你有冰霜之躯、腐烂之鳃与未名梦魇！
布琳洛特将你送回深海。”
— 威勒姆·罗斯
flavour.sourceEn:
"From what beast you derived, we can only fathom.
Aye, you of living ice, rotting gill, and untold nightmare!
We Brinerot return ye to the sea."
- Weylam Roth

flavour.en:
With a flick of the finger, their fates are written,
the pages torn to a million pieces.
flavour.zh: 弹指一挥间，命运已书写，篇幅皆四散。
flavour.sourceEn:
With a flick of the finger, their fates are written,
the pages torn to a million pieces.

flavour.en:
The ring I stole,
My finger they took,
A shrouded mind,
Cut their curses short,
As I drained their spirit
And stole their soul.
A blessing is often a curse.
flavour.zh:
我偷了枚戒指，
被人家砍下一手指，
我心已受蒙蔽，
对其诅咒漫不在意，
我吸尽他们心神，
窃取他们灵魂。
祝福往往招致咒诅。
flavour.sourceEn:
The ring I stole,
My finger they took,
A shrouded mind,
Cut their curses short,
As I drained their spirit
And stole their soul.
A blessing is often a curse.

flavour.en:
A gift, a braid, of golden hair.
The war, forgotten.
The reason, remembered.
flavour.zh:
一份礼物，一缕金色的发辫。
战争，早已被遗忘。
理由，却铭记在心。
flavour.sourceEn:
A gift, a braid, of golden hair.
The war, forgotten.
The reason, remembered.

flavour.en:
We may fight, and we may die, but in these
moments of blood and battle, we truly live.
flavour.zh:
我们可能会战斗，我们可能会战死，
但在流血和战斗的时刻，我们真正地活着。
flavour.sourceEn:
We may fight, and we may die, but in these
moments of blood and battle, we truly live.

flavour.en:
The roar of the heavens
Strikes more than fear
Into the hearts of Man
flavour.zh:
天庭狂嚎震怒
神罚永不饶恕
人心恐惧无助
flavour.sourceEn:
The roar of the heavens
Strikes more than fear
Into the hearts of Man

flavour.en:
Where legends tread,
the world hearkens.
flavour.zh:
传奇所到之处，
天地为之撼动。
flavour.sourceEn:
Where legends tread,
the world hearkens.

flavour.en:
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.
flavour.zh:
海水击岩石，
一日复一日，
待到洞穿时，
惊海之王兴。
flavour.sourceEn:
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.

flavour.en:
Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the
rhoaback riders—death charging from the sands.
flavour.zh:
风中回荡呼啸并非雷鸣之声，
那是恐喙鸟骑士的搏命冲锋。
flavour.sourceEn:
Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the
rhoaback riders—death charging from the sands.

flavour.en: The truly mighty are never outnumbered.
flavour.zh: 真正的力量不会屈服于数量。
flavour.sourceEn: The truly mighty are never outnumbered.

flavour.en:
The largest beings on Wraeclast
are not flesh and blood.
flavour.zh:
瓦尔克拉斯最庞大的生灵
并不是血肉之躯。
flavour.sourceEn:
The largest beings on Wraeclast
are not flesh and blood.

flavour.en:
Ezomyte loyalty was not given to distant leaders.
It was earned by comrades in arms.
flavour.zh:
艾兹麦人不会向高高在上的领袖效忠，
只有同胞战友才能赢得忠心。
flavour.sourceEn:
Ezomyte loyalty was not given to distant leaders.
It was earned by comrades in arms.

flavour.en: The art of surgery advances one mistake at a time.
flavour.zh: 手术之道的进步，源于一个个错误。
flavour.sourceEn: The art of surgery advances one mistake at a time.

flavour.en: Infinite mutations over endless eons borne upon it in a singular moment.
flavour.zh: 无尽岁月中的无数突变，于刹那之间尽数加诸其身。
flavour.sourceEn: Infinite mutations over endless eons borne upon it in a singular moment.

flavour.en:
The might of the Eternal Empire was formidable,
but rebels of every culture stood together as one.
flavour.zh:
永恒帝国威势滔天，
然各路仁人义士众志成城。
flavour.sourceEn:
The might of the Eternal Empire was formidable,
but rebels of every culture stood together as one.

flavour.en:
Uhtred drank. Verisium burned through his veins.
He gazed at death's face. With all his strength,
he turned instead to the stars, and witnessed Truth.
flavour.zh:
乌崔德饮下了维金。
维金在血脉中灼烧。他凝视着死亡的面庞。
他用尽全力，转而望向星辰，从而见证了真理。
flavour.sourceEn:
Uhtred drank. Verisium burned through his veins.
He gazed at death's face. With all his strength,
he turned instead to the stars, and witnessed Truth.

flavour.en:
"The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3
flavour.zh:
“不曾锈蚀绝不代表纯净。”
——伊席厄斯·普兰德斯，《珍奇古玩大典》，第3号物品
flavour.sourceEn:
"The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3

flavour.en:
They believed themselves driven by necessity,
but that desperation made them monstrous.
flavour.zh:
他们自认为是被逼无奈，
但正是这种绝望把他们变成了恶魔。
flavour.sourceEn:
They believed themselves driven by necessity,
but that desperation made them monstrous.

flavour.en: Gentle anger, raging calm.
flavour.zh: 平静与愤怒有时是一体两面。
flavour.sourceEn: Gentle anger, raging calm.

flavour.en:
The sea swells, the sky thunders; two ships tilt at odds.
Flashes of light show only swinging axes... and a grin.
flavour.zh:
海涛汹汹，天雷滚滚，双舸竞斗冲。
电闪破黑云，刀光映斧影，唯见寒笑森森。
flavour.sourceEn:
The sea swells, the sky thunders; two ships tilt at odds.
Flashes of light show only swinging axes... and a grin.

flavour.en:
Unlike the other gods, when he was born from the volcano,
Valako rode the clouds of ash into the thundering sky.
flavour.zh:
瓦拉克自火山诞生，不同于其他神明。
他乘着灰烬之云，腾飞到雷鸣的高空。
flavour.sourceEn:
Unlike the other gods, when he was born from the volcano,
Valako rode the clouds of ash into the thundering sky.

flavour.en:
The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness,
Watered by suffering,
Tended by desperation,
And bloom steel flowers of victory.
flavour.zh:
伟业种籽，栽于黑暗，
蒙受苦难浇灌，
遭到绝望照管，
方能绽放胜利的铁花瓣。
flavour.sourceEn:
The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness,
Watered by suffering,
Tended by desperation,
And bloom steel flowers of victory.

flavour.en:
The tribe revelled wildly, unaware that each fruit
they ate further bound their continuity to the fog's.
In time, the merest touch could break their reality.
flavour.zh:
部族纵情狂欢，未觉所食的每一颗果实，
都令他们的存续与迷雾的存续愈发紧密地绑定。
日久，最轻微的触碰，也足以令他们的现实崩碎。
flavour.sourceEn:
The tribe revelled wildly, unaware that each fruit
they ate further bound their continuity to the fog's.
In time, the merest touch could break their reality.

flavour.en:
There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake,
but few have the resolve to attempt it.
flavour.zh:
只有一种方式能逃过冰蛇的毒牙，
但甚少有人敢下决心。
flavour.sourceEn:
There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake,
but few have the resolve to attempt it.

flavour.en:
In a blaze of glory,
An anomaly defying all odds
The "unkillable" beast met the divine
And Ventor met his latest trophy.
flavour.zh:
至辉荣耀，劣境克敌
“不败”怪物终遭天谴
芬多取得毕生最后胜绩。
flavour.sourceEn:
In a blaze of glory,
An anomaly defying all odds
The "unkillable" beast met the divine
And Ventor met his latest trophy.

flavour.en:
"Your covetous hands bring the Unlight
ever closer to consuming your realm."
flavour.zh:
“你贪婪的双手将暗光之域日益拉近，
直至吞噬你的国度。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Your covetous hands bring the Unlight
ever closer to consuming your realm."

flavour.en:
The warriors of the Unblinking Eye moved
together as one, shoulder to shoulder.
flavour.zh:
凝望之眼的战士们，
并肩同行，进退如一。
flavour.sourceEn:
The warriors of the Unblinking Eye moved
together as one, shoulder to shoulder.

flavour.en:
Reap what others have sown
Muster them from their graves
Parade them for your pleasure
Zealots in mortis enslaved
flavour.zh:
莫让前人耕耘回归尘土
休使学问埋入坟墓
呼唤前人出坟阔步，
奴役亡躯，踏上征途。
flavour.sourceEn:
Reap what others have sown
Muster them from their graves
Parade them for your pleasure
Zealots in mortis enslaved

flavour.en:
Tale-women do not fight as dekharas.
They command a power all their own.
flavour.zh:
说书人虽不像德卡拉一样征战，
却也掌控着只属于自己的力量。
flavour.sourceEn:
Tale-women do not fight as dekharas.
They command a power all their own.

flavour.en: Only a madman would ignore a god's instructions.
flavour.zh: 只有疯子才无视天神的指引。
flavour.sourceEn: Only a madman would ignore a god's instructions.

flavour.en:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
flavour.zh:
福尔骁勇善战，登基称王
奈何治国无方，终至灭亡
flavour.sourceEn:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.

flavour.en:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
flavour.zh:
福尔骁勇善战，登基称王
奈何治国无方，终至灭亡
flavour.sourceEn:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.

flavour.en:
The eldritch storm descended upon us, and bruised lightning
rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.
flavour.zh:
奇异风暴在我头顶笼罩，
雷霆风暴在我眼前宣泄
秘术让手上的金属熔解，生命零凋，
奔逃无路，求助无门！绝望永不止歇……
flavour.sourceEn:
The eldritch storm descended upon us, and bruised lightning
rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.

flavour.en: Clever artifice is not always complex.
flavour.zh: 奇谋妙计不应该费尽心机。
flavour.sourceEn: Clever artifice is not always complex.

flavour.en:
Tempest's power given form,
Flee before the walking storm.
flavour.zh:
风暴成形，初生乍现，
伺机而动，逃出生天。
flavour.sourceEn:
Tempest's power given form,
Flee before the walking storm.

flavour.en:
Knowing she could outlast any opponent,
Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.
flavour.zh:
华士敏深知自己能拖垮对手，
战斗时不求速胜，但求持久。
flavour.sourceEn:
Knowing she could outlast any opponent,
Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.

flavour.en: All the world is my home.
flavour.zh: 敝人以天地为家。
flavour.sourceEn: All the world is my home.

flavour.en:
"Move in ways your enemy does not expect.
Confuse them with elegance and grace.
They'll never see the axe coming."
- Rakiata, Chieftain of the Tasalio Tribe
flavour.zh:
“行动当出其不意
以优雅身姿欺敌，
斧刃便所向无敌。”
——拉其塔，塔萨里奥部落的酋长
flavour.sourceEn:
"Move in ways your enemy does not expect.
Confuse them with elegance and grace.
They'll never see the axe coming."
- Rakiata, Chieftain of the Tasalio Tribe

flavour.en:
Forged by the last remaining brother
to return all that was once given.
flavour.zh:
仅存的兄弟锻造出了它，
将获赠的一切物归原主。
flavour.sourceEn:
Forged by the last remaining brother
to return all that was once given.

flavour.en:
That day, both the Unblinking Eye and
their enemies stood in silence. That day,
the sky was clear, but it was raining.
flavour.zh:
那一日，凝望之眼与宿敌
相逢却沉默无言。那一日，
晴空万里，雨却打湿了脸。
flavour.sourceEn:
That day, both the Unblinking Eye and
their enemies stood in silence. That day,
the sky was clear, but it was raining.

flavour.en:
"I loosed a volley of arrows into the heart of the man
who slew my beloved. There was no satisfaction, no
healing, no revenge. There was only... emptiness."
flavour.zh:
“我射出连珠箭矢飞入害我爱人的凶手的心脏。
但这并没有给我带来满足，
没有治愈，没有复仇。只留下一片……空虚。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"I loosed a volley of arrows into the heart of the man
who slew my beloved. There was no satisfaction, no
healing, no revenge. There was only... emptiness."

flavour.en:
"Beyond fire, blood, and nightmare,
the Saviour will build Utopia."
flavour.zh:
“跨越火焰、鲜血与梦魇，
救赎者必将筑起乌托邦。”
flavour.sourceEn:
"Beyond fire, blood, and nightmare,
the Saviour will build Utopia."

flavour.en:
The mocking wind, a shielding spell,
The haunting screams, a maddening hell
flavour.zh:
恶风袭击，召出护身宝具，
尖啸不息，目睹烈刑恶狱
flavour.sourceEn:
The mocking wind, a shielding spell,
The haunting screams, a maddening hell

flavour.en: The older brother retained calm in the midst of fury.
flavour.zh: 在狂怒与喧嚣之中，哥哥依然保持着冷静。
flavour.sourceEn: The older brother retained calm in the midst of fury.

flavour.en: Wonders abound at death's door.
flavour.zh: 濒临死亡之际，人总能创造奇迹。
flavour.sourceEn: Wonders abound at death's door.

flavour.en:
The Counts of Ogham share a
legacy of cunning and power.
flavour.zh:
欧甘伯爵世袭血脉，
传承着狡黠与力量。
flavour.sourceEn:
The Counts of Ogham share a
legacy of cunning and power.

flavour.en: Shaped metal never forgets the forge.
flavour.zh: 塑成的金属永远铭记着锻炉的锤炼。
flavour.sourceEn: Shaped metal never forgets the forge.

flavour.en:
We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.
flavour.zh:
我们是他的血肉。
透过我们，他散播炙热的启示。
flavour.sourceEn:
We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.

flavour.en: Let the unrepentant be dragged ever downwards by the weight of their sins.
flavour.zh: 让冥顽不灵者深陷罪恶的泥沼吧。
flavour.sourceEn: Let the unrepentant be dragged ever downwards by the weight of their sins.

flavour.en:
Feed a beast and it will not hunt.
Protect it and it will not fight.
Ferocity must be learned, not taught.
It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.
flavour.zh:
喂食野兽，它就不会伤害你·
保护它野兽 它就不会与你为敌·
暴行最易被模仿却无法被教授·
只有疼痛能够打造最强的战士·
flavour.sourceEn:
Feed a beast and it will not hunt.
Protect it and it will not fight.
Ferocity must be learned, not taught.
It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.

flavour.en:
The relative peace under the fledgling Empire saw
the first Sekhema to choose, in her resplendent age and
wisdom, to step down. The role of Zaitema was born.
flavour.zh:
羽翼未丰的帝国治下相对的和平时期，
见证了首位丝克玛在其光辉岁月与智慧之年选择退位。
扎特玛这一角色由此诞生。
flavour.sourceEn:
The relative peace under the fledgling Empire saw
the first Sekhema to choose, in her resplendent age and
wisdom, to step down. The role of Zaitema was born.

flavour.en: The most horrifying ideas often begin with a simple innovation.
flavour.zh: 最恐怖的创意，往往诞生于一个简单的创新。
flavour.sourceEn: The most horrifying ideas often begin with a simple innovation.

flavour.en:
Mortality is a curse.
The cure is simple.
flavour.zh:
终末乃是诅咒。
解咒轻而易举。
flavour.sourceEn:
Mortality is a curse.
The cure is simple.
